plugins.readme_text:
# @chi-hong22/dsh-session-autoname

DeepSeek Harness host plugin: name a new conversation once, at its first naming
opportunity, as `MMDD｜类型｜主题` — the DSH port of a Codex `Stop`-hook renaming
setup. It also names any specified conversation on demand by summarizing its whole
content, and it catches up on sessions that were never named because the host died
mid-turn.

Installs as a profile bundle — from GitHub, or from the out-of-tree working copy at
`D:\__CODE__\_tookit\261002_dsh-session-autoname`:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Chi-hong22/dsh-session-autoname
# local development:
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "D:/__CODE__/_tookit/261002_dsh-session-autoname"
# or through the harness: plugin_manager install_bundle link:D:/__CODE__/_tookit/261002_dsh-session-autoname
```

## Responsibilities

### 1. Automatic naming

- Trigger: the durable `turn/end` event of ANY turn on a root session
  (`session/event`) — normally turn 1, but also a later turn when the first one was
  lost. No `hooks.json`, no `Stop` handler, and **no title provider
  registration** — see below.
- Evidence: turn 1's own completed result when it has one (the user request plus
  the work that turn actually delivered, folded from the session log); otherwise
  the whole conversation so far, which is what keeps a session whose first turn was
  interrupted or killed still nameable.
- Date: `MMDD` from the session's own `header.createdAt` in `Asia/Shanghai`
  (never `updatedAt`, never the host clock).
- Write: `ctx.sessionTitle.rename()`, the interface the GUI itself uses.
- Skip conditions: not a root session; no assistant text anywhere; the human
  already renamed the session; the title is already compliant. Every failure keeps
  the title already on the session, and the reason is recorded in the admin tool's
  `auto.recent` ring.
- Exactly once: a compliant title, or a user-chosen one, ends the attempts, so
  later turns do nothing.

Accepted output is rebuilt from validated parts and must be exactly
`MMDD｜类型｜主题`: the date must equal the `createdAt`-derived value, the type must
be one of 功能/设计/修复/优化/发布/探索/文档/研究/诊断/验证, the separator must be
full-width `｜`, and the topic must be non-empty, within 24 characters and 60
bytes, free of control characters, and free of the project name. Markdown, code
fences, prose, extra JSON fields, `{"title":null}`, and over-long titles are all
rejected rather than guessed. A model call that ends `max-tokens` is still
accepted when the text it emitted parses and validates — a reasoning route can
exhaust its budget before stopping.

### 2. Naming a specified conversation

`session_title_admin` with `{"action":"summarize","session_id":"…"}` reads the
WHOLE conversation — its opening intent plus the per-turn outcomes that fit a
byte budget, biased to the end where the result lives — and writes one
`MMDD｜类型｜主题` title for it. `dry_run:true` previews without writing. Live
sessions are written through `sessionTitle.rename`; cold ones through
`sessionController.rename`. The same date and type rules apply.

Other actions: `list` (recent root sessions, their titles, and recent automatic
outcomes), `inspect` (one session's first-turn evidence), `apply` (exact renames,
each re-validated against that session's own `createdAt`), `archive` (hide
throwaway test sessions), `selftest` (create a throwaway session and prove real
first-turn auto-naming end to end).

### 3. Catch-up sweep after a crash or restart

The trigger above is a live event, so a host that dies mid-turn never delivers the
`turn/end` that would have named the session — and after the restart that turn is
restored as an open turn that can never end as `completed`. Five seconds after this
plugin applies, it therefore names every root session that is **still without a
compliant title** and holds assistant work, inside a bounded window:

| Bound | Value | Why |
|---|---|---|
| window | 48 h of `header.createdAt` | the crash case is minutes old; older sessions are reached when they are continued, or by `summarize` |
| cap | 5 named per start | a start must never become a mass rename of history |
| delay | 5 s | the sweep must not compete with the host's own startup |

Each outcome lands in `auto.recent` (`named` / `skipped` / `failed`, plus one
`sweep` line carrying the counts), so a start can be audited without reading logs.

## Why nothing has to be disabled

`ctx.sessionTitle.register()` accepts exactly ONE provider, and the stock
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-title-first-prompt-llm` occupies it. This plugin avoids
the conflict instead of resolving it in configuration:

- It never calls `register()`, so the slot's single-owner rule is irrelevant; the
  official provider stays enabled and untouched.
- `sessionTitle.rename()` calls `supersede()` internally, which aborts that
  provider's in-flight generation and invalidates its pending one, and a
  user-source title pins the session against later automatic revisions.
- Net effect: while the first turn runs, the sidebar shows the stock provider's
  plain-text title as a placeholder; once the turn closes, this plugin replaces it
  with the compliant one.

## Wiring

`cordis.patch.yml` is this bundle's patch layer — one row, no foreign rows:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: session-autoname
      name: '@chi-hong22/dsh-session-autoname'
```

The row names the package rather than a file URL, so the bundle runs wherever it is
fetched from — `github:Chi-hong22/dsh-session-autoname` included. A bare name is
safe here because an installed copy is immutable: the loader resolves each specifier
once per host process, and that single resolution points at the installed package
for the life of the process.

For local development this profile links the working copy
(`link:D:/__CODE__/_tookit/261002_dsh-session-autoname`), so the same bare name
resolves through the junction to this checkout's `session-naming.js` — checked with
`import.meta.resolve` from the profile directory. Editing the file and restarting
DSH loads the edited code.

> Need the row to be unable to name anything but this checkout (for example when an
> older copy of the package is also reachable from the profile)? Override it in the
> profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`: `- id: session-autoname` with
> `name: 'file:///D:/__CODE__/_tookit/261002_dsh-session-autoname/session-naming.js'`.

## Reloading after a code edit

Restart DSH — it re-imports the resolved file. Without a restart the module URL has
to change, and a package-name row always resolves to the same file: switch to the
file-URL override above, pointed at a renamed copy of the implementation file, so
the loader sees a URL it has not cached.

## Verifying

```powershell
node --test tests/provider.test.mjs      # offline: rules, rejections, trigger skips, catch-up, admin tool
node tools/history-evidence.mjs 0        # read-only first-turn digests of root sessions
```

Then on a live host: `session_title_admin {"action":"selftest"}` for the automatic
path, and `{"action":"list"}` to read the recent automatic outcomes.

## Known limits

- Automatic naming cannot run "before the answer is delivered": DSH streams the
  answer to the browser while the turn runs. The title lands as soon as the first
  turn closes, without delaying it.
- A first turn that ends `aborted`, `interrupted`, `error`, or `max-tokens` is
  named from the whole conversation instead of from that turn's partial result, and
  the model is told to stay conservative about the type. Only a session with no
  assistant work at all is left unnamed — name it later with `summarize`.
- The catch-up sweep is bounded (48 h, 5 per start). A session older than the window
  that was never continued and never named keeps its placeholder until `summarize`
  is asked for it.
- `sessionController.rename` resumes a cold session, so naming one whose recorded
  `agentPreset` no longer exists fails with `Unknown agent preset`.
- `D:\__CODE__` is inside a file-sync scope on this machine, so in-place edits can
  briefly fail with a Windows sharing violation; retry.

plugins.description: Laya Tool Router Using the SystemOne Jev Typed Decisions for Local Laya Model and Equivalents.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Tool Router

Lazy tool discovery for DSH: hides every tool schema from the model's prefill
and reveals exactly one tool on demand through a **decision model API**.

- **Prefill cost:** one small `find_tool` schema instead of every mounted tool
  (26 schemas on a default Standard profile — see [Why?](#why)).
- **Stage 0** — full-surface send: every mounted tool (≤ 24) carries a
  160-char criterion, ordered by a stopword-filtered lexical rank (the rank
  only bounds pathological mounts — d1-omni does not saturate as the choice
  count grows; see [Why?](#why)).
- **Stage 1** — one `POST /v1/systemone` to the decision model API: a
  `bestTool` choice plus a `usable` question kept as telemetry only
  (~235–500 tokens, ~6–7 s on-device).
- **Stage 2** — accept iff `confidence >= 0.70`: return the winner's JSON
  Schema and reveal exactly that one tool; otherwise return a
  **probability-ordered shortlist** whose reason names the closest match, so
  the model can retry with that exact tool name (or send an empty request to
  get the whole catalog). Exact tool-name requests skip the decision call and
  reveal instantly.

## Why?

Fresh session, first message, server-reported `usage.prompt_tokens` —
the DSH **Standard preset** (the platform default) versus this plugin's
`no-prefill` preset:

| Cost before the first word | Standard | no-prefill |
|---|---:|---:|
| Prefill tokens | **6,559** | **283** |
| System prompt | 5,816 chars | 372 chars |
| Tool schemas shipped up front | **26 schemas (21,417 B)** | 1 schema (697 B) |

Standard makes the model ingest a 5.8k-character system prompt plus **every**
mounted tool schema — 6,559 tokens — before it emits a single word, and pays
it again on every subsequent turn. `no-prefill` ingests 283 tokens (**23×
less**, 96% smaller prefill): a slim persona plus the single `find_tool`
schema. On the measured backend that difference was ~40 s versus ~14 min of
prompt evaluation for the first reply.

What that buys you:

- **Latency** — time-to-first-word scales with the whole tool shelf today.
  Reveal-on-demand makes it scale with the tool you actually call.
- **Context budget** — 6.5k tokens of standing preamble is 6.5k tokens you
  don't have for code, conversation, and results. On a 32k window that's ~20%
  of the model's world spent before work starts.
- **Reliability on small models** — a model reading 26 schemas behaves like a
  model reading 26 instructions it must never violate. One schema at a time is
  one schema to follow; the rest of the shelf doesn't exist for it.
- **Pay for what you use** — a turn that calls no tool costs 283 tokens
  instead of 6,559. A turn that calls one tool reveals that one schema once;
  the other 25 are never sent.

If a session ends up using most tools anyway, the gap narrows — but the unused
half of the shelf is exactly what a default profile charges for from word one.

## What the bundle patch declares

`cordis.patch.yml` (applied when the bundle is selected):

1. **`preset-no-prefill`** — an agent preset whose composition is only
   `persona` + `dsh-tool-router`. The persona tells the model: no tools are
   declared; call `find_tool` first — and if a result carries no schema,
   retry with an exact tool name or an empty request instead of giving up.
2. **Host tool rows enabled** — `tool-bash`, `tool-fs`, `tool-fs-search`,
   `tool-todo`, `tool-web` flipped to `disabled: false`, plus a `present`
   row inserted. Discovery needs the tools to exist somewhere; preset-scoped
   registrations shadow host ones, so other presets keep their own behavior.
   The slim preset keeps the Agent Presets page showing only `find_tool`.

## Prerequisites

- DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 (bundles mechanism with `dsh.bundle.patch`).
- A running **decision model API** that speaks `POST /v1/systemone`
  (the router defaults to `http://127.0.0.1:8081/v1/systemone`; edit
  `ROUTER_BASE` in `index.js` to point at another host or port).
- `pnpm` on PATH of the host running DSH (the plugin manager installs
  through pnpm; the CLI forwards pnpm arguments).

## Install

**From GitHub (recommended):** Plugins → install → spec

```
git+https://github.com/residenthiago2011/DSH-Tool-Router.git
```

or via the CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add git+https://github.com/residenthiago2011/DSH-Tool-Router.git
```

**From a prebuilt tarball:** download
[`dsh-tool-router.tgz`](https://github.com/residenthiago2011/DSH-Tool-Router/releases/latest/download/dsh-tool-router.tgz)
from Releases, then install from the local path (also accepted: absolute
path, git URL, or an npm registry name after publishing):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /path/to/dsh-tool-router.tgz
```

Then select the bundle on the Plugins page (installation enables it by
default) and restart DSH if the profile runs without HMR.

## Uninstall

Deselect/remove the bundle on the Plugins page. The preset row and the host
tool flips vanish with the bundle patch; other presets are untouched.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | The router plugin: registers `find_tool`, masks every other tool per agent, runs the 3-stage decision. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The bundle patch: preset declaration + host tool enablement. |
| `tool-registry.json` | Stage-0 labels and Stage-1 criteria (25 tools, both shells incl. `bash`). |

## Tests

```sh
node router-import-test.mjs   # module shape (no dependencies)
node rank-sim.mjs             # Stage-0 ranking on sample queries (needs tool-registry.json)
node router-e2e-test.mjs      # full flow: arm/deny-set/live reveal — requires the decision endpoint at 127.0.0.1:8081
```

`router-e2e-test.mjs` uses a stub DSH context that emits `tools/change`
synchronously (the worst case that once caused a ~970x feedback loop), then
drives the real `find_tool` against a live decision endpoint: armed-once,
deny-set dedup, late registration, reveal re-arm, empty-request catalog hint,
and the exact-name fast path. `ALL_PASS` is expected.

## Notes

- `find_tool` registers with a standard JSON Schema
  (`type/properties/required/additionalProperties`). A raw register with
  author-style parameters reaches the LLM unconstrained — the model then
  calls with `{}`. Always compile.
- The empty-request catalog hint and the exact-name fast path exist for
  small models; see `execute()` in `index.js`.

# Fly Skins — palettes for the DeepSeek Harness web UI

Four light/dark palettes for the official DeepSeek Harness web UI, a cyan scanline that runs only
while the model works, and a HUD sidebar.

**四套明暗配色、只在模型运行时出现的青色扫描线，以及 HUD 侧栏。**

`@dsh-fly/dsh-plugin-fly-skins` · category **theme** · MIT

> **Preview data.** The screenshots below are the official DeepSeek Harness UI with this skin
> installed — no Fly workbench, fresh profile. Workspaces and sessions are sample or blank-profile
> data (example names include `atlas-web`, `billing-api`, `infra-notes`); the sidebar crop shows a
> blank default workspace. No real conversations appear.
>
> **预览数据**：下面的截图是官方 DeepSeek Harness UI + 本皮肤（没有 Fly 工作台、全新 profile）。
> 工作区/会话是示例或空白 profile 数据（示例名包括 `atlas-web` / `billing-api` / `infra-notes`），
> 侧栏截图显示的是空白默认工作区；不含任何真实会话。

![Neon, dark, on the official UI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ethanchen669/dsh-plugin-fly-skins/main/docs/shots/preview-neon-dark.jpg)

## Four palettes

| Palette | id | Look | Pick it when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Solid** | `solid` | Opaque panels, crisp borders | You want a flat, high-contrast room |
| **Glass** | `glass` | Translucent frosted surfaces, hairline edges | You want depth without colour |
| **Volume** | `volume` | Glass volume + state glow + text plates | You want the lit, sculpted read |
| **Neon** | `neon` | Scene light field + edge glow + text plates + dark-half running scan | You want the scene-light field (default in dsh-fly) |

Every palette has a light and a dark half. The choice persists in the profile's patch layer
(field `skin`), so it survives restarts and profile switches.

**四套配色各有明暗两半**，选择写进 profile 的 patch 层（`skin` 字段），重启和切换 profile 后保留。

![Solid, dark, on the official UI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ethanchen669/dsh-plugin-fly-skins/main/docs/shots/preview-solid-dark.jpg)

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile=<profile> add @dsh-fly/dsh-plugin-fly-skins
```

Or add it from **Settings → Plugins** in the harness UI, then **restart** the app — the engine
caches client bundles in-process, so a page refresh is not enough.

Once installed, the palette picker appears as its own row in **Settings → General**:

![The Skin row in Settings → General](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ethanchen669/dsh-plugin-fly-skins/main/docs/shots/official-neon-dark-settings.jpg)

It works standalone: install the skin without the Fly workbench and you get the official UI in
Fly colours; install the workbench without the skin and you get the official look plus the
workbench.

**独立可用**：不装 Fly 工作台也有官方 UI 的 Fly 配色；只装工作台不装皮肤则是官方外观 + 工作台。

## Features

### Scene light field

Neon paints a scene light field behind the whole window: deep navy canvas, a 46px circuit grid
running edge to edge, cyan edge glow bleeding out of the rail card, and text sitting on its own
plate so it stays sharp over the field. Dark and light are two halves of one recipe, not two
themes.

**霓虹在整窗画一张场景光场**：深蓝画布 + 46px 电路网格、栏卡外溢青光、文字坐字座；明暗两半是同一套
配方的两个半区。

### Running scanline

In the neon dark half, when a turn is running, a **2px** cyan line sweeps bottom-to-top through
the conversation column, trailing a **48px** glow in the same cyan as the todo panel's ring
(`rgba(53, 211, 224, 0.78)`, T10). It is tied to the harness's own running marker
(`data-chat-running`): the line exists only while the model is working and is gone the moment the
turn settles. It is a background layer — it does not paint over glyphs — but it can show through
transparent gaps in text and surfaces; idle reading never gets a moving line. Off under
`prefers-reduced-motion` and at ≤768px.

**模型工作时才扫**：2px 青线自下而上扫过中列，尾迹 48px、与 Todo 任务列表卡 T10 同色
`rgba(53,211,224,.78)`。线挂在引擎自己的 `data-chat-running` 上，模型一停就消失；它画在背景层、
不盖字形，但会从文字/表面的透明缝隙透出来；静态翻阅不扫。`prefers-reduced-motion` 与 ≤768px
下关闭。

![A five-step example task running: the expanded todo card, the expanded command card and the scan line](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ethanchen669/dsh-plugin-fly-skins/main/docs/shots/preview-neon-dark-tasks.jpg)

### HUD sidebar

Workspace folders are a cyan HUD badge: pending cyan (`#35d3e0` dark / `#0f6f7d` light),
**13px**, weight 600, 0.12em tracking, uppercase Latin, with the folder icon in the same cyan and
a 1px trailing gradient rule. The row keeps the upstream surface — no extra plate or bar. Session
rows are unchanged: 17.5px white 400 with the pill selection. 13px is deliberate: 14px clipped
`DEFAULT WORKSPACE` to `DEFAULT WORKSP…` in the 280px rail, so the badge keeps the full label one
step below the session type.

**侧栏工作区文件夹是青色 HUD 标牌**：pending 青（深色 `#35d3e0` / 浅色 `#0f6f7d`）、13px、600、
0.12em 字距、英文大写，文件夹图标同色，右侧一条 1px 渐隐尾线；行本身没有额外底板/色条。会话行不动：
17.5px 白字 400 + 胶囊选中态。13px 是有意的：14px 会把 `DEFAULT WORKSPACE` 截成
`DEFAULT WORKSP…`（280px 轨道实测），所以保留完整标签，只比会话行低一档。

![Workspace folder HUD badge in the official sidebar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ethanchen669/dsh-plugin-fly-skins/main/docs/shots/official-sidebar.jpg)

### Type

Latin is MiSans Latin, embedded (~166KB, Apache-2.0, three weights) so the chrome keeps its HUD
voice offline; Chinese falls back to your own font setting. Buttons and panel titles take 600
weight with 0.04em tracking, section labels 500, numerals are tabular, and timestamps/counts
switch to the mono stack. Sidebar text is 125% (14→17.5px); the HUD workspace badge is the 13px
exception above. MiSans Latin is scoped to neon; solid / glass / volume keep their shipped body
type and pixels, apart from the shared 125% sidebar scale and the HUD workspace badge.

**字体**：拉丁用内置 MiSans Latin（~166KB，Apache-2.0，三档字重），中文回落用户字体；按钮/面板
标题 600 + 0.04em，section 500，数字等宽，时间戳/计数走等宽栈。侧栏文字 125%（14→17.5px），HUD
工作区标牌是上面的 13px 例外。MiSans Latin 只作用于霓虹；其余三套配色保留原身体字体与像素，共享的
只有 125% 侧栏字号和 HUD 工作区标牌。

## Compatibility

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Harness engine | `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.x` (verified on `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`) |
| Node | ≥ 20 |
| Peer | `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` `^3.18.4` (the engine supplies the rest at load time) |

The package declares `dsh.bundle` + `dsh.client`: the host half contributes a loader row, a
boot-time palette marker and the `flySkins` service; the client half contributes the token
override layer, the stylesheet and the settings UI.

**兼容性**：引擎 0.2.x（在 `0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.2.1-rc.2` 验过）；Node ≥20；peer 只有
`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`。包声明 `dsh.bundle` + `dsh.client`。

## Data and network

The skin is tokens, CSS and an embedded font. It makes no external network requests, loads no CDN
fonts and collects no conversation data. MiSans Latin is shipped in the client bundle; the host
half publishes the loader row, the boot palette marker, the settings surface and the `flySkins`
service.

**数据与网络**：皮肤只包含 token、CSS 与内置字体；不向外部发网络请求、不拉 CDN 字体、不采集会话
内容。MiSans Latin 随客户端包内嵌；宿主半边发布 loader 行、启动配色标记和设置面。

## Development & internals

Everything about building, the two contracts (boot marker and the `flySkins` service), the
directory layout, the upstream-hook rules, how `dsh-fly` consumes this repo, and the release
checklist lives in **[docs/maintainers.md](https://github.com/ethanchen669/dsh-plugin-fly-skins/blob/main/docs/maintainers.md)**.

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run verify     # build + typecheck + tests
```

**开发**：构建、boot 标记与 `flySkins` 服务两条契约、目录、上游钩子规则、dsh-fly 如何消费本仓、
发布清单都在 [docs/maintainers.md](https://github.com/ethanchen669/dsh-plugin-fly-skins/blob/main/docs/maintainers.md)；`pnpm run verify` 跑构建 + 类型 + 测试。

## Changelog

See **[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ethanchen669/dsh-plugin-fly-skins/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)** — 0.2.7 is the current README/marketplace release; 0.2.6 was
the first npm-published 0.2.x release (B HUD sidebar, running-only scan, MiSans Latin).

## License

[MIT](https://github.com/ethanchen669/dsh-plugin-fly-skins/blob/main/LICENSE). MiSans Latin is Apache-2.0; see [LICENSES/](https://github.com/ethanchen669/dsh-plugin-fly-skins/tree/main/LICENSES/). First split out of the
`dsh-fly` monorepo (`packages/dsh-plugin-fly-skins`); `scripts/build-client.mjs` and
`scripts/lib/client-src-hash.mjs` are byte-identical copies, guarded by assertions on both sides.

**许可**：MIT；MiSans Latin 为 Apache-2.0，见 [LICENSES/](https://github.com/ethanchen

plugins.description: OneBot v11 hub for DeepSeek Harness: relays QQ events verbatim to downstream bots while giving the agent a full timeline, action ledger and 28 onebot_* tools.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-onebot-hub **把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 QQ（OneBot v11）上，并让它看清整条链路发生了什么。**

中文 | [English](#english)
> **已经有一个 NoneBot 机器人，又用不上 DSH？** > 那这个插件解决不了你的问题——它自己不是聊天机器人，只是把 **DSH agent** 和一个看得见的 > OneBot 枢纽接在一起。想要一个能直接聊天的群友，装 > [nonebot-plugin-aigf-master](https://github.com/Funny1Potato/nonebot-plugin-aigf-master) > 就行：记忆、人设、表情包、什么时候该开口，它都自带。 > 往下读的前提是这两个之一：**你想让 DSH 进群**，或者**你想看清群里到底发生了什么**。 ## 📖 这是什么 一句话：**它是一个 OneBot v11 的"枢纽"**——上面接真正登录着 QQ 的实现端，下面接你的 NoneBot 插件，中间坐着 DSH 的 agent。 ``` QQ 客户端（真人在聊天） │ ▼ ┌──────────────────────────┐ │ QQ 实现端 │ LLOneBot / NapCat / go-cqhttp └────────────┬─────────────┘ │ OneBot v11 WebSocket ▼ ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ dsh-onebot-hub │ │ ① 上游：收全部事件，持有全部 action │ │ ② 观测：时间线 / 谁做了什么 / 原始报文 │ │ ③ agent：记忆、人设、决定要不要说话 │ │ ④ 下游：把事件原样转发给 N 个下游 bot │ └────────────────────────┬───────────────┘ │ OneBot v11（四种连法任选，可多条） ▼ NoneBot / 其它 OneBot bot（可多个） ``` ### 为什么需要它 → 它能替你做什么 | 你想要 | 没有 hub | 有 hub | | --- | --- | --- | | 让 DSH 进群聊天 | DSH 不认 OneBot 协议，接不上 | agent 拿到全部消息与全部 action | | 机器人到底在干什么 | 只能翻日志猜 | `onebot_timeline` 看消息、`onebot_turns` 看"谁引发了什么"、`onebot_raw` 看原始报文 | | 想换/加一个下游 bot | 得把 QQ 实现端重新接一遍 | 加一条 `downstreamTargets`，现有插件**一行代码都不用改**（事件原样转发） | | 试探下游插件又怕惊动群 | 真发消息试 | 探针走**另一个账号**，真人消息串不进去 | | 一个群一个模型/一个角色 | 做不到 | 白名单 + 人设预设 + 分群额度，逐群配 | > 只想让 DSH 在群里说话、不接任何下游 bot？完全可以：`downstreamTargets` 留空就行。 ## ✅ 前置条件 开始之前，你至少需要： 1. **一个 QQ 实现端**（真正登录着 QQ 号的那一层）：LLOneBot、NapCat、go-cqhttp 等，且它支持 OneBot v11 的 WebSocket（反向或正向都行）。 2. **一个能跑的 DSH**（DeepSeek Harness），并且里面配好了可用的模型。 3. 可选：想路由给下游的 NoneBot 插件（没有也能用）。 > 插件本身**不需要** Python、不需要编译，运行时只依赖 `ws`，包里自带构建好的 `lib/`。 ## 💿 安装 插件已发布到 npm：[`dsh-onebot-hub`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-onebot-hub)。 用 DSH 自带的插件管理器装进某个 profile（`<你的 profile>` 换成 profile 名，比如 `desktop`）： ```sh dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-onebot-hub ``` 这条命令只是把参数转给该 profile 目录下的 pnpm，所以等价写法是： ```sh cd ~/.dsh/profiles/<你的 profile> pnpm add dsh-onebot-hub ```
装完要不要手改 cordis.patch.yml？ **默认不需要**。包里声明了 `dsh.bundle`，装好会被自动并入 profile 的插件层。 万一个别版本的 DSH 没有自动并入，就在该 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里**追加**下面三行（别动已有条目）再重启： ```yaml - insert: - id: onebot-hub name: 'dsh-onebot-hub' ```
想装开发版 / 自己改过的版本？ ```sh pnpm add github:Funny1Potato/dsh-onebot-hub # Git 源：拉源码，需要 prepare 脚本并放行构建 pnpm add file:D:/path/to/dsh-onebot-hub # 本地目录：改完重启即生效 ```
装好后**重启 DSH**，设置页里会多出一个「OneBot 枢纽」分节。 ## 🚀 五分钟上手 ### 第 1 步：装好并重启 打开 DSH 设置页 →「OneBot 枢纽」，能看到一堆配置项就说明插件加载成功了。 ### 第 2 步：把你的 QQ 实现端接上来 推荐**让实现端反连 hub**（不用在 hub 里填上游地址，实现端换 IP 也不影响）： 1. 在设置页填 `upstreamListen`： ``` 127.0.0.1:8765/onebot/v11/ws ``` > 这是"监听地址 + 路径"，写什么就监听什么，**不写路径只接受根路径 `/`**。 2. 在 LLOneBot（或 NapCat）里打开 **WebSocket 反向（反向 WS）**，地址填同一个： ``` ws://127.0.0.1:8765/onebot/v11/ws ``` 3. 保存 → 重启 DSH（或直接在设置页保存，效果一样）。 **怎么确认接上了**：在 hub 自己的会话里问它一句，让它调 `onebot_hub_status`；或者看设置页顶部状态。日志在 `/startup.log`（默认 `~/.dsh/onebot-hub/startup.log`）。 > 也可以反过来——hub 主动拨实现端：填 `upstreamUrl`（形如 `ws://127.0.0.1:3001`），`upstreamListen` 留空。两者**二选一**。 ### 第 3 步：告诉它"哪些群可以说话" **默认它是全静音的**：不写白名单，任何群、任何人 @ 它都不响。 - `agent.groups`：允许调模型的群号，JSON 数组，如 `["123456789"]` - `agent.privates`：允许调模型的 QQ 号，JSON 数组，如 `["10001"]` - `chatCommands.superUsers`：谁能用聊天里的管理命令，如 `["10001"]`（**留空 = 整条命令链沉默**） **怎么确认**：在群里敲 `/status`，超管应该能收到一条状态回执。 ### 第 4 步：在群里 @ 它 被 `@`、被引用、或者私聊发消息，它才会醒——醒了会参与一会儿，之后没人理它就自己睡回去。 **至此最小可用配置就完成了**，剩下的都是按需打开。 ## ⚙️ 配置 **全部配置项与默认值见 [docs/config.md](docs/config.md)**（设置页里每个字段的中文名和说明也来自那里，二者由测试对账，不会各说各话）。 ### 最少要配的 | 键 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | `upstreamListen` | 接哪台 QQ 实现端。推荐用它（让实现端反连）。与 `upstreamUrl` 二选一 | | `downstreamTargets` | 下游列表，JSON 数组，可多条。**不接下游就留空** | | `agent.groups` / `agent.privates` | 白名单：写了的群/QQ 才调模型。两张都空 = 全部静音 | | `chatCommands.superUsers` | 谁能用管理命令。留空 = 命令链整条沉默 | ### 常改的 | 键 | 什么时候改它 | | --- | --- | | `agent.mode` | `assist`（默认，被叫到才醒）/ `observer`（只看不说）/ `active`（休眠时每 5 分钟看一眼有没有新消息） | | `agent.batchSize` / `agent.batchMs` | 一批攒几条（默认 10）、等多久（默认 20000 ms） | | `agent.speakAssistantText` | 默认 `false`：**普通回复文本只是内部草稿，只有调 `onebot_reply` 才会真发进群** | | `agent.replyMaxText` / `replyMaxImages` / `replyGapMs` | 一次回复最多几条文字（3）、几张图（9）、条与条之间隔多久（400 ms） | | `chatCommands.prefix` / `bypassPrefix` | 命令前缀（默认 `/`）、让路前缀（默认 `!!`） | | `vision.mode` | 看图方式：`describe`（把图交给视觉模型写成人话，默认）/ `segment`（把图本身给模型）/ `off` | | `persona.presets` | 群里的角色设定（名字、性格、说话风格），可按群套用 | | `memes.enabled` / `memes.maxSend` | 表情包库；收哪张由 agent 自己决定，`maxSend` 限一次发几张 | | `imageGen.enabled` | 让 agent 自己生图（默认关，填 `model`/`baseUrl`/`apiKey` 才开） | | `anime.backend` | 二次元角色识别（默认 `off`；[anime-recognize](https://github.com/Funny1Potato/aigfm-anime-recognize) 本地 / `animetrace` 公共 API / `both`） | | `memory.isolation.level` | 记忆隔离：`strict` / `scoped` / `balanced`（默认）/ `open`，见[记忆系统](#-记忆系统) | | `memory.peopleRoster` | 上下文里【本群认识的人】最多列几个（默认 20；`0` = 整段不注入） | | `retention.days` | 原始报文与媒体保留天数（默认 7） | | `probe.isolation` | 试探下游时怎么和真人消息隔开：`off`（默认）/ `time`（时间窗）/ `link`（另开探针账号），见[探针](#探针试探下游不惊动群) | | `code.scopes` | 下游 bot 的源码目录。地址不写进 prompt，agent 需要时用 `onebot_code_scopes` 取 | | `agent.groups` 行内的 `quota` | 分群额度，**逐行配**，见[额度](#额度分群记账) | ### 设置页 设置页里的每个字段都有中文名、配置键和一句说明；改动**先暂存**，点保存才落盘（个别字段标了 `volatile`，改了立刻生效）。宽屏是左右两栏，窄屏会自动堆叠成上下结构。 ## 💬 聊天里的命令（13 条） 只有 `chatCommands.superUsers` 里的账号能用（**留空 = 整条命令链沉默**）。别人敲同样的字，枢纽一声不吭——回一句"你没权限"等于告诉全群这里有个能管事的 bot。 **下表省略前缀**：前缀由 `chatCommands.prefix` 定（默认 `/`）。配成 `!` 就敲 `!help`——命令名本身不变。 | 命令 | 别名 | 作用 | | --- | --- | --- | | `help` | `帮助` `?` | 列出这 13 条 | | `status` | `状态` | 链路、模式、时间线、运行时长、人设、表情包一屏概览 | | `presets` | `preset` `预设` | 列出可用人设预设（`→` 表示本会话在用） | | `set_preset <预设名>` | `set_presets` `设置预设` | 把本会话切到某个预设 | | `set_role <名字> <设定>` | `设置角色` | 临时给本会话换个角色名和设定 | | `preset_role <设定>` | `设置设定` | 只改设定，不改角色名 | | `memes` ｜ `memes del ` | `表情包` `meme` | 看最近 10 个；`del` 删掉某个 | | `reload_meme` | `重载表情包` | 从磁盘重读一遍表情包索引 | | `perm [预设名]` | `permission` `权限` | 看 / 换**本会话 agent** 的权限预设（只管本次激活） | | `model [provider/model｜编号｜default]` | `模型` `聊天模型` | 看 / 换本会话的聊天模型 | | `vmodel [provider/model｜编号｜default]` | `视觉模型` `识图模型` | 看 / 换本会话的识图模型 | | `reset` | `重置` | 本会话的人设绑定与模型选择回初始（**不动长期记忆**） | | `quota [reset [额度]]` | `额度` | 查今天/本月用量；`reset` 抹掉今天已用，带数字＝追加额度 | 三条要知道的语义： 1. **命令不吞消息**：命中后消息照常转发给下游、照常给模型看，只跳过"喂模型"这一步（枢纽已经用同一个账号答过这句话）。 2. **前缀撞车 = 两个都触发**，不是谁先谁赢。想让枢纽别管某一条，加让路前缀：`!!/help`。 3. **只在开头认前缀**：`你好 /status` 是聊天，不是命令。回话超 `chatCommands.maxReplyChars`（默认 1500 字）会截断。 ## 🧠 记忆系统 agent 不是"每轮都把聊天记录读一遍"，它有**三层心智 + 五个落点**： | 层 | 记什么 | 什么时候用 | | --- | --- | --- | | **活跃层** | 现在活着的事：进行中的话题、agent 正在做的事 | 每轮都注入，做完要结算 | | **长期记忆** | 群里值得记住的**事件**，一行一条 | 每轮常驻，是"索引" | | **人物档案** | 关于某个人的稳定事实：处境、答应过什么、爱聊什么 | 聊到这个人时注入 | | **群档案** | 群名、人数、群主、公告、群氛围 | 只在本群注入 | | **话题归档** | 一件事的细节：事件、参与人、结论、起止时间 | 按 id 查，不常驻 | ### 活跃层：它现在在干什么 活跃层回答两个问题——「这个群现在在聊什么」和「我自己正在做什么」。注入时长这样： ``` 【进行中的话题】 0. [群 55555] 讨论换显卡型号，卡在电源瓦数上 1. [与 10001 的私聊] 帮我改插件的配置项 【我正在做的事】 2. [群 55555] 正在替小张整理显卡选购清单 ``` - **每条都带出处**，所以你在 A 群能看见"B 群还在聊什么"——不会张冠李戴。 - 做完一件事要**结算**：留在长期记忆里一行摘要，或者直接删掉。一直不结算的条目，一天后会提醒它一次。 - 活跃层**跨会话共享**要看隔离档位和白名单，见下。 ### 长期记忆：一行一条的索引 ``` 0. [群 123456789] 群里最后定了磨豆机买 A 款（2026-10-06；相关：小张） 1. [群 55555] 周末的抽奖活动取消了（2026-10-02） ``` - 行首是**出处**，行尾是**日期**和**跟谁有关**。 - 它是**索引**：细节在档案里，方括号会告诉你去哪儿看（`〔详见 话题：显卡选购〕`）。 - `related_users` 不是"这条记的是谁"，而是**"这件事跟谁有关"**——带上了，它就只会在"这些人也在的群"里被想起来。 ### 隔离：谁能看见什么 `memory.isolation.level` 四档（默认 `balanced`）： | 档位 | 别的

plugins.description: 一款用于DSH的插件，可以直接使用DSH搜索并下载图片
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-search-picture

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：**让智能体上网找图 → 你先看预览 → 满意的才写进相册。**

工作流是两步的，这一点很重要：

1. 你说「帮我找几张 XX 的图片」，智能体调 `search_picture`：多图源搜索 → 按清晰度筛选 → 下载到**预览区** → 把图片本身读进上下文，逐张告诉你「这是哪张、哪些建议留」。
2. 你说「第 1、3 张满意」，智能体调 `save_pictures`：只把这几张**平铺写入相册**（默认 `%USERPROFILE%\Pictures\dsh-search-picture\`），其余从预览区删除。

**在你确认之前，相册里不会出现任何东西。**

## 目录约定

```
downloads/                              下载根目录（配置里的 directory），只放预览区
└── .staging/<批次 id>/                 预览区：候选先落这里，随时可整批丢弃
    ├── STAGING.md                      本批清单（人可读：分辨率/来源/直链）
    └── 查询词-01.jpg                   候选文件（文件名 = 查询词 + 序号）

%USERPROFILE%\Pictures\dsh-search-picture\     相册：图片**平铺**，不建任何子文件夹
├── 查询词-01.jpg
└── 查询词-03.jpg
```

- **相册是一个固定目录、图片平铺**，不按每次要求建子文件夹（`folder` 参数已弃用）。
- 写入是**复制而非移动**：确认过的图仍留在预览区，方便你改主意时再要一次。
- 相册内重名会自动追加 `-2`、`-3`，**绝不覆盖**已有图片。
- **预览区在下次搜索时自动清理**：新搜索开始前会删掉上一次留下的批次（`autoCleanPreview: false` 可关闭）。**当前批次永不删除**；只清「批次 id」形态的目录，其他名字的目录一律保留，避免误删。
- 确认后若预览区已空，`downloads/.staging/<批次 id>/` 会被整个移除，不留空壳。
- ⚠️ **相册在工作区之外**，而会话沙箱默认是 `workspace-write`：写入需要一次「放宽到完全访问」的批准（`ask` 授权策略下会弹给你确认；没有可用应答方时该次写入会失败）。这是刻意的——宁可让你点一次授权，也不静默往工作区外写文件。

## 功能

| 环节 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 官方素材 | **默认关闭**（`officialSite: true` 可开启）。官网首页按活动批次展示横幅与联动广告，实测**不含用户点名的角色**（拿到的多是活动主视觉，甚至别的角色的立绘）——对「找某个具体角色」这个主要用途，官网素材是噪声 |
| 相关站点 | **萌娘百科默认开启**（`relatedSites`）：去与主题关联的百科站找图。动漫类的**作品视觉图/立绘**主要靠它——实测某作品词条一次可拿到 8 张位图（含 1856×2618 等大图），且图床裸请求可下。另可选 `biligame`，但它**启用了 WAF**、实测会返回 HTTP 567 拦截页，故默认关闭 |
| 水印过滤 | 用户要求「不要自动添加水印的图片」。插件没有视觉模型，**无法通用判断一张图有没有水印**；但图库站的水印是产品行为，所以按**域名黑名单**（58pic/699pic/gettyimages…）＋**地址含 `watermark`/`水印` 标记**两条确定性判据排除，结果里会报告排除了几张（`watermarkHosts` 可追加域名） |
| 插画源 | **Safebooru**（`tags` 参数启用）：画师同人插画，能拿到超大原图（实测 850×1328 ~ **5039×7874**、11 MB），无防盗链。但它**只做标签字面匹配**——带空格的自然语言查不到，必须用下划线连接的标签形式（见下方 `tags` 说明），因此中文/自然语言查询不会去查它（避免引入不相关噪声）。**新推出的角色往往还没有标签**（实测多个新角色为 0 条） |
| 搜索 | 并发查询 **Bing 图片**、**百度图片**、**360 图片**、**哔哩哔哩图文** 四个免 key 图源，按图片地址去重合并 |
| 来源偏好 | **知乎与哔哩哔哩优先**（用户指定）。按**站点**判定而非引擎——百度和必应都会索引知乎/B 站的图，用户在意的是图最终来自哪个站。偏好**只在质量相当时**起并列作用，绝不越级（历史教训：曾让官网升到最高档，结果横幅挤掉了全部插画） |
| 可直贴标记 | `hotlinkFriendly` 标出「图床无防盗链、直链可安全嵌入回复显示」的图（`zhimg.com` / `hdslb.com` / `safebooru.org`）。回复正文只认 `http(s)` 图片源，本地路径会被渲染成文字占位符 |
| 清晰度 | **保底 720p**（默认门槛 921600 px² = 1280×720），1080p 以上自然排前；下载后按**实际解码尺寸**三重校验：像素面积、长边 ≥1000、长宽比 ≤2.6，不达标直接淘汰并记录原因 |
| 原图优先 | 百度优先取明文原图（`replaceUrl`）或解码后的 `objURL`；拿不到原图才退化到百度 CDN 的受限代理图，且排序降到第二档 |
| B 站 | 站内没有图片搜索，因此引擎**只调用** `search/type=article`（专栏正文配图）与 `link_draw`（图文图片集）；**不使用视频封面**（那是 UP 主给视频做的标题图，不是「这张图」本身）。宁可返回「无结果」——原本的「视频封面兜底」解析器已按此要求**移除** |
| 排序 | 先降档受限代理图与标题图，其余按像素面积降序；面积相同时**知乎/B 站优先**，再相同则官网素材优先 |
| 防盗链 | 先**不带 Referer** 请求（多数图床带第三方 Referer 才拒绝），失败再带来源页 Referer，最后退化到搜索结果里的缩略图地址 |
| 限流 | B 站搜索对匿名连发请求会返回 `HTTP 412` 或 `-412 request was banned`；实测约 4 秒恢复，因此按 2.5s/5s/7.5s 递增退避重试 |
| 展示 | 同一批字节提交为 DSH 附件 → 模型收到真正的图片块；同时写入 `tool/result.meta`，Client 半据此渲染缩略图画廊与「保存结果」卡片（工具卡片**默认折叠**，展开后可见缩略图） |

### 相关站点（百科类）与它的坑

用户要求「动漫可以去**萌娘百科**这类的网站，其他图片去与它相关联的网站找」。实测（[test/probes/probe-related-sites*.mjs](test/probes/)）确定了几件事：

| 站点 / 接口 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 萌娘百科 `opensearch` | ✅ 能精确命中词条，含消歧义名（搜角色名会列出「角色名」/「角色名(作品名)」等同名项） |
| 萌娘百科 **`list=search`** | ❌ `action-notallowed: Unauthorized API call`——**词条检索只能用 `opensearch`** |
| 萌娘百科 **`prop=imageinfo`** | ❌ 同样是未授权接口！**必须用 `generator=images` 才能拿到图与真实 URL** |
| 萌娘百科图床 `storage.moegirl.org.cn` | ✅ **裸请求可下**（实测 1856×2618 / 895KB） |
| biligame wiki | ⚠️ 首次可用（下载到 1052×1362），随后**全部请求被 Tencent EdgeOne WAF 拦为 HTTP 567**（返回 HTML 而非 JSON）→ 默认关闭，且代码里必须容错 |

实现要点（见 [src/related.js](src/related.js)）：

- 只用 MediaWiki 的 `opensearch`（找词条）＋ `generator=images`（取图 + `iiprop=url|size`），一次请求就能拿到「图 + 真实 URL + 尺寸」；
- **过滤掉 SVG 与站点自用素材**：词条图里混着编辑图标、模板 logo、Commons 徽章，按文件名关键词（`logo|icon|emblem|commons-|nuvola|…`）排除；
- **WAF 拦截要能被识别**：拦截页是 HTML，直接 `JSON.parse` 会抛 `Unexpected token '<'` 这种难懂的错，所以先判首字符，命中就报「被 WAF 拦截（HTTP 567），本轮跳过」，不影响其他图源。

### 关于「不要带水印的图片」

这是用户明确要求，但要**如实说明能力边界**：本插件没有视觉模型，**无法通用地判断一张图里有没有水印**（那需要看图）。所以实现的是两条**确定性**判据：

1. **域名黑名单**：图库/素材站（`58pic.com`、`699pic.com`、`ibaotu.com`、`gettyimages.com`、`shutterstock.com` …）给预览图统一加水印，这是**产品行为**，按域名排除可靠；配置项 `watermarkHosts` 可追加。
2. **地址/文件名标记**：URL 或文件名里带 `watermark`、`水印` 等字样。

命中的候选在下载前就被剔除，并在结果里报告「已按不带水印要求排除 N 张」。**做不到的**：那些把水印压在画面里的普通站点图——这需要逐张看图，插件层面做不到，只能靠模型在预览时用眼睛判断。

### 知乎：为什么是「搭搜索引擎的便车」而不是直连
用户要求优先用知乎的图。实测（[test/probes/probe-zhihu.mjs](test/probes/probe-zhihu.mjs)、[probe-zhihu2.mjs](test/probes/probe-zhihu2.mjs)）表明**知乎站内完全进不去**：

| 入口 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 搜索页 / 问题页 HTML | **HTTP 403**（移动 UA、伪造 cookie、`Baiduspider`/`Googlebot` UA 全都是 403） |
| `api/v4/search_v3` | **HTTP 400**（各种参数组合均 400） |
| 热榜 / 推荐 feed | **HTTP 401** `身份未经过验证` |
| 文章 API / 答案 API | 403（err 10003 / 40353）、收藏夹 401 |
| **`pic*.zhimg.com` 图床** | **HTTP 200**，无 referer 与带 referer 都能下 |

所以正确做法是：**走百度（对知乎收录最好）命中 `zhimg.com` 的图，直接从图床取原图**。因为图床无防盗链，这些直链还能**直接嵌进回复显示**——这是本插件唯一被验证能在回复正文里显示图片的形式。


### 官网图源的边界（实测记录）

对象为某游戏官网与某产品官网，脚本见 [test/selftest-official.mjs](test/selftest-official.mjs)：

- **找官网稳**：Bing 网页搜索结果的站外链接里第一条就是国服官网（标题自带「官方网站」），可稳定识别，第三方站（bilibili / 4399 / taptap / 百科…）会被排除；
- **取图成**：国服与国际站首页各抽出 21 条图片地址，HTTP 200 **全部可下**，其中 **20 条 ≥720p**；
- **但拿不到「指定角色」的图**：官网是 Next.js 客户端渲染，初始 HTML 里**没有任何站内 `<a href>`**，无法顺着链接进入角色页；图片目录按「日期 + 哈希」组织，从 URL 也看不出对应关系。所以官网图源只能作为**权威高分的补充**，不能宣称「帮你找到了那个角色的官图」。

> 踩坑记录：图片地址抽取**不能把 `,` 或 `&` 当分隔符**——`?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1920&v=2` 这类地址被削掉尾段后就变成 404。这个 bug 曾让我把官网 20 张可下载的大图误判成「官网取不到图」。


## 工具

### `search_picture`（搜索到预览区）

| 参数 | 必填 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `query` | 是 | 图片内容描述，中英文均可 |
| `count` | 否 | 搜索张数，默认取配置 `count`，不得超过它 |
| `page` | 否 | 结果页码（0 起）；第一页没有满意结果时翻页 |
| `folder` | 否 | 已弃用：现在图片平铺写入相册，不再按请求建子文件夹，该参数会被忽略 |
| `tags` | 否 | **Safebooru 插画站**的检索标签，英文 romaji 形式、**下划线连接**，例如 `character_name_(series_name)`、`series_name`。多个标签用空格表示「同时满足」。想要画师同人插画就填它；**纯中文查询不要填**（该站只认标签字面匹配，中文会得到 0 结果） |

返回里包含 `sourceFolder`（下载根目录）、`previewFolder`（预览区）、`targetFolder`（**相册目录**）、`officialSites`（找到的官网）、每张图的 `path`/`width`/`height`/`bytes`/`sourceUrl`/`pageUrl`/`hotlinkFriendly`，以及图片块本身。

> `targetFolder` 指向的是**相册**（默认 `%USERPROFILE%\Pictures\dsh-search-picture`），不是工作区里的目录——这是「不建文件夹、直接进相册」这个要求的结果。

> `hotlinkFriendly` 标出「图床无防盗链、直链可直接嵌进回复显示」的图（`zhimg.com` / `hdslb.com` / `safebooru.org`）。**回复正文只认 `http(s)` 图片源**，本地路径会被渲染成文字占位符——这一条是实测踩坑后写进代码注释的。

### `save_pictures`（确认后写入相册）

| 参数 | 必填 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `keep` | 是 | 要写入相册的图片：预览清单里的**序号**（`"2"`、`"#5"`）或**文件名** |
| `folder` | 否 | 已弃用（仅为兼容旧调用保留），会被忽略 |
| `discard` | 否 | 明确不要的图片（序号或文件名），会从预览区删除 |
| `previewFolder` | 否 | 预览区绝对路径或批次 id；默认用下载根目录下的预览区 |
| `sourceFolder` | 否 | 下载根目录；默认用配置里的 `directory` |

**只有用户明确表示满意之后才应该调用它**（工具描述里写明了这一点）。

## 安装

**给使用者：一键安装（推荐）**

从 [Releases](https://github.com/tuanzi0v0/dsh-search-picture/releases) 页面下载 `dsh-search-picture-<版本>.tgz`，或用它的固定直链（**`latest` 永远指向最新版**）：

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle  target: https://github.com/tuanzi0v0/dsh-search-picture/releases/latest/download/dsh-search-picture-0.4.9.tgz
```

也可以直接指向仓库（需要安装机器上有 `git`，DSH 会先用 `git ls-remote` 检查可达性）：

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle  target: https://github.com/tuanzi0v0/dsh-search-picture
```

安装后 **重启 DSH** 生效（Host 半的 JS 模块只在启动时加载）。Client 半由 `/plugins/<包名>/client.js` 动态提供，不需要重建前端。

> 为什么推荐 tarball：DSH 的插件管理器对 **tarball 形式跳过 GitHub 可达性检查**，也不需要使用者本机装 git，链路更短。

**给开发者：从本地目录安装**

包必须能被 profile 解析到，因此需要装进 profile（`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>`）。官方插件管理器（GUI 的 Plugins 页面，或 Creator 模式下的 `plugin_manager`）：

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle  target: <本包绝对目录>
```

命令行等价做法（在本包目录下）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "$(pwd)"
```

或先打包再用 tarball：

```bash
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-search-picture-<version>.tgz
```

（把 `<version>` 换成 `package.json` 里的版本号。**每次改动后必须加版本号再打包**，原因见下方「开发循环」。）


## 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里按行 id 覆盖（patch 替换整份 `config`，要改的键都要写上）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-search-picture
  name: dsh-search-picture
  config:
    directory: downloads      # 下载根目录（只放预览区）；相对路径按会话工作区解析
    count: 6                  # 每次默认搜索张数（也是 count 参数的上限）
    album: ''                # 相册根目录；留空 = %USERPROFILE%\Pictures
    albumName: dsh-search-picture   # 相册内的固定子目录名（图片平铺其中）
    autoCleanPreview: true    # 下次搜索时自动清理上次的预览批次（

plugins.description: 通过经历增量积累记忆、修正认识、逐渐形成理解的认知系统（Accumulate memory, revise knowledge and gradually form a cognitive system of understanding through incremental experience.）

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) # Incremind **A second brain that remembers what is new.** Give it the material you choose. It organizes and archives it, extracts what adds to **what you already know**, and turns proposed insights into long-term memory only after you confirm them. [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Features](#features) · [Evaluation](#evaluation-and-verification) · [Usage](#usage) · [Architecture](#architecture) · [Privacy](#privacy-and-data) · [Development](#development) ![Python 3.12](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.12-3776AB?logo=python&logoColor=white) ![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-009688?logo=fastapi&logoColor=white) ![React 19](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-19-61DAFB?logo=react&logoColor=black) ![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-local--first-003B57?logo=sqlite&logoColor=white) [![License: AGPL-3.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-AGPL--3.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE) ![Windows](https://img.shields.io/badge/Windows-10%20%7C%2011-0078D4?logo=windows&logoColor=white)
## Watch the introduction A 2:45 walkthrough of adding material, confirming new insights, and asking a follow-up question. Chinese narration with Chinese and English subtitles · 1080p60. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8f51499d-bbfb-47a2-9ab0-91193313f1f0 [Download video](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8f51499d-bbfb-47a2-9ab0-91193313f1f0) · [English subtitles (SRT)](docs/media/incremind-intro.en.srt) · [English subtitles (VTT)](docs/media/incremind-intro.en.vtt) ## Why I am building it I want a second brain that can work alongside me over time. The idea comes from everyday research. Whenever I ask AI a question or give it a task about the same project, I have to explain the background, my existing judgments, and the material I have already found all over again. Knowledge accumulates, but conversations often start from scratch. Incremind is designed around two goals: 1. **Turn things I share into lasting knowledge.** Accept articles, personal judgments, recordings, videos, and ideas captured on the go; organize them by project and scene; and turn them into knowledge I can revisit and insights I can confirm. 2. **Use that knowledge to understand questions and complete tasks.** Identify what I am asking, find the relevant projects and scenes, and give the model their existing insights, sources, and context so it can answer everyday questions and handle routine tasks with less repeated explanation. Saving articles and videos does not automatically make their contents useful or memorable. Incremind therefore focuses on **what each new source adds**: - **Compare new material with existing insights.** Extract three kinds of changes: **additions** such as new conditions, examples, or practices; **differences** from an existing claim; and **new methods**. Material that repeats what you already know adds a supporting source to the existing insight rather than creating another entry. - **Store methods with their conditions of use.** Each insight says when it applies, so relevant methods can be recalled when you ask a question or work on a task. - **Let you decide what becomes established knowledge.** Extracted insights start as pending confirmation. A single click on the receipt activates them. Confirmation, edits, and forgetting take effect immediately; further inference runs in the background. - **Remember and forget in a human-like way.** Frequently used knowledge becomes stronger, while unused knowledge gradually leaves automatic recall. Originals remain in the Library and can be found and restored at any time. For example, an introductory article on spaced repetition might produce an insight about reviewing on days 1, 2, 4, 7, and 15. A later article on active recall and adaptive intervals should add only the relevant differences and methods: adjust intervals to difficulty, and try answering before revealing the answer. ## Features | Status | Feature | What it does | |---|---|---| | ✅ | **One input box** | Automatically handles remembering, asking, and doing tasks. Mixed requests, such as a reminder followed by a question, are split and handled separately. | | ✅ | **Automatic organization** | Builds memory in layers: original → organized note + summary → insight. Supports text, links, PDFs, and DOCX files. | | ✅ | **Automatic project assignment** | Without an explicit `#Project`, assigns material to the most relevant existing project or creates one for a new topic. Everyday items stay in the Everyday space. Assignment can be undone with one click. | | ✅ | **Incremental insights** | Compares material with existing insights and proposes additions, differences, and new methods for confirmation on the receipt. | | ✅ | **Answers with citations** | Uses eligible insights, summaries, organized notes, and originals as evidence; citations open the original source. Questions in Everyday can be routed to the relevant project. | | 🧪 | Agentic retrieval | The model decides whether to search or read again, can consult applicable skills enabled for the current project and configured web search, and asks for missing conditions before continuing in the same conversation. See [Agentic RAG](docs/agentic-rag.md) (Chinese) for the S1–S4 stages and validation scope. | | ✅ | **Task execution** | Uses project memory, confirmed profile facts, and Library lookup to create output documents, which you can continue revising or regenerate. Real DeepSeek initial-draft and continuation runs have verified note facts, version history, and source provenance. | | ✅ | **Library** | Browse insights, summaries, organized notes, and originals; confirm, edit, forget, or restore insights. Recover unsaved note edits in the same browser, with revision checks when saving. View saved revision metadata from the editor menu. | | ✅ | **Privacy controls** | Keeps data on the computer or server hosting the application, excludes private projects from external model requests, and records a receipt for each external call. | | 🧪 | More input formats | Image OCR, audio and video transcription, and Bilibili favorites import; requires the corresponding models to be configured. | | 🧪 | Forgetting and daily organization | Adjusts recall weights by usage and a forgetting curve. Daily organization proposes patterns from recurring material for your confirmation. | | 🧪 | Local embeddings | Install EmbeddingGemma from Settings, approximately 1.5 GB, for semantic retrieval without a network connection. | | 🧪 | Claude Code, Codex, and DeepSeek Harness | All three clients can access memory tools through plugins. Workbench delegation saves new drafts; server-side delegation is currently limited to DeepSeek Harness. See installation requirements and validation limits in [the agent guide](docs/agents.md) (Chinese). | | 🧪 | Servers and multiple users | Home or cloud server deployment, device pairing, backup, and recovery. See [the server guide](docs/server.md) (Chinese). | ✅ Basic usage paths are implemented. 🧪 Optional dependencies or further real-environment validation are required. The table below states the actual validation scope; the icons do not establish coverage of every scenario. ## Evaluation and verification ![Server holdout answer quality, evidence recall, latency, and recorded tokens](docs/images/evaluation-heldout.svg) The same frozen 48 questions were run twice on a server with 4 logical CPUs and 7.35 GiB memory, using real DeepSeek Flash and CPU EmbeddingGemma 2 through the normal Workbench ask workflow. The dataset contains four conversations, 116 sessions, and 2,536 messages; it has no conversation or question-text overlap with the development set. | Metric | Initial `retrieve@7` | Repair `retrieve@8` | |---|---:|---:| | Attempted questions | 48 / 48 | 48 / 48 | | Correct / partially correct / wrong | 1 / 0 / 29 | 22 / 11 / 5 | | Clarificat

plugins.description: 同时显示AI模型和供应商
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-show

A [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) client plugin for the Web UI: the composer's model
selector shows **Provider/Model** instead of a bare model name, so a selected model always names
the provider it comes from.

| | Composer trigger |
|---|---|
| Before | `Example Chat · High` |
| After  | `Example Provider/Example Chat · High` |

The dropdown menu is untouched: rows stay plain (`Example Chat`) under their provider
headings, and search keeps matching plain model names. The hover tooltip and ARIA label carry the
same `Provider/Model` text as the visible trigger.

![Composer trigger reading OpenCode Zen/DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Default](docs/composer-trigger.png)

A real trigger: provider `OpenCode Zen`, model `DeepSeek V4.1 Flash`; the trailing `Default` is the
thinking-effort suffix DSH already appends.

## Requirements

- DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.1 < 0.3.0-0` or `>= 0.2.1-rc.1 < 0.4.0-0`, `web` client platform (developed
  against the Desktop runtime `0.2.0-rc.2`, re-vendored and tested against `0.2.1-rc.2`).
- The built-in model selection plugin (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection`) must stay
  enabled. This plugin reuses its `modelDirectories` service and only shadows the composer seat.
- Provider names are whatever your own model configuration declares (`displayName` of each
  provider row), e.g. `Example Provider`, `Example Vendor`.

## Install

### Plugin market

Open the plugin market in the target DSH app, search for the package name `dsh-model-show`,
install it, then enable it.

### Desktop CLI

The Desktop app ships its own CLI (the reserved `desktop` profile is managed only by it):

```console
"%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add dsh-model-show
```

From GitHub, or from a local checkout:

```console
"%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add github:<user>/dsh-model-show
"%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add "C:\path\to\dsh-model-show"
```

Remove it with `plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-model-show`.

### From a DSH session

Ask the agent to install the bundle from this directory (`plugin_manager` with
`action: install_bundle` and the package directory as `target`).

Reload the page after installing. Replacing an already-loaded plugin with a different build needs
an application restart.

## Verify

1. The composer trigger reads `Provider/Model` (plus `· <effort>` when the model reports a
   reasoning effort).
2. Hovering it shows the same text.
3. The menu still lists plain model names under provider headings, and searching a provider name
   does not match models.

## How it works

- `lib/index.js` is the plugin's (empty) node half, so the bundle can be mounted by the profile's
  layer stack; the browser half is discovered through `dsh.client` + `exports["./client"]`.
- `cordis.patch.yml` inserts one row (`id: model-show`, `name: dsh-model-show`).
- `lib/client.js` is the built-in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection` browser bundle with
  six documented edits (`scripts/vendor-from-asar.mjs`, each marked with an `EDIT:` comment in
  the generated file). The two that produce the visible change are the provider-prefixed
  `choices[].model.name` and registering the composer seat at `priority: -1`, which shadows the
  built-in seat because the lowest priority renders. The upstream `inject` list is left untouched
  (see Limitations — the seat resolves its catalog through the consuming context).
- The label is prefixed where the trigger reads it (`currentChoice?.model.name`), so the menu's own
  `groups` — and therefore search — stay untouched.

## Development

```console
npm test                 # offline checks: manifest, the six edits, and the label behaviour
npm run vendor           # re-extract the upstream bundle from the installed app and re-apply the edits
npm run vendor:check     # exit non-zero when the shipped bundle is not the vendored one
```

`npm run vendor` reads
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\app.asar` →
`dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection/lib/client.js`, or a client bundle
passed with `--from <client.js>` / an archive with `--asar <app.asar>`.

If upstream moves an anchor, vendoring fails loudly (`anchor not found (<label>) — upstream
bundle changed?`) instead of shipping a broken bundle; review the edits against the new bundle and
update the script, then re-run `npm test`.

Line endings are normalised to LF by `.gitattributes`. `lib/client.js` is compared byte for byte
against the vendored output, so a CRLF checkout would fail both `npm test` and `npm run vendor:check`.

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | Bundle and client manifest (`dsh.bundle.patch`, `dsh.client`) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the plugin row into the profile layer stack |
| `lib/index.js` | Node half (empty `apply`, so the row can mount) |
| `lib/client.js` | Vendored browser bundle with the six edits |
| `scripts/vendor-from-asar.mjs` | Vendoring: extract from an installed DSH, apply and verify the edits |
| `tests/verify-bundle.test.mjs` | Offline verification of the shipped bundle |
| `icon.svg`, `locale/*.json` | Plugin Manager card metadata |
| `screenshots.json`, `docs/composer-trigger.png` | Storefront screenshot, declared in-repo so the market reads it from here |

## Limitations

- `lib/client.js` is a vendored copy of a built-in bundle, so it also requires
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`, `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, and
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store` from the browser module table (declared in
  `dsh.client.external`). A redesign of the built-in model selector in a future DSH release can
  break this bundle; `engines.dsh`, the vendoring script, and `npm test` are the guard rails.
- The plugin inherits the built-in control wholesale, including its stylesheet and its
  `min(360px, 45cqw)` trigger width; a long `Provider/Model` label is ellipsized rather than
  wrapped.
- The vendored bundle deliberately keeps the built-in plugin's whole service list (`commandUi`,
  `locale`, `sessions`, `slots`, `remote`, `remote.session`). The seat resolves its per-session
  catalog through the *consuming* context, so trimming the list to the services this plugin visibly
  uses throws `cannot get property "remote.session" without inject` on the first render after a
  launch; the slot registry then retires the crashing entry and the built-in seat renders instead —
  with no error shown anywhere. `npm run vendor` and `npm test` guard against that edit returning.
- No configuration: the format is fixed to `Provider/Model`.

## License

MIT. `lib/client.js` is derived from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection` (MIT,
Copyright (c) DeepSeek). See [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md).

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: real OS notifications (Windows Action Center, macOS Notification Center) when a turn finishes, fails, or an agent waits for your confirmation.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-notify

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DeepSeek Harness plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4B6BFB.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

Real operating-system notifications for DeepSeek Harness: a Windows Action Center toast, a macOS Notification Center banner, or a Linux notification-daemon message, raised when DSH needs you back at the window.

## What it notifies

| Moment | Source |
|---|---|
| A turn finished | `api-session/status` remote event, `running` true → false |
| A turn failed | `api-session/error` remote event |
| A background job settled | the `jobsBySession` mirror on the client session list |
| An agent is waiting for confirmation | `uiSession.pendingInteractions` (approval, user question, plan review) |

Clicking a notification focuses the window and opens the session it came from.

## Install

### Option 1: the prebuilt tarball (recommended, no build authorization)

Download `dsh-notify-0.1.0.tgz` from [Releases](https://github.com/Zhiyi-Zhao/dsh-notify/releases):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-notify-0.1.0.tgz
```

The built artifacts ship inside the package and no build script runs during installation (verified against an isolated profile).

### Option 2: straight from GitHub

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Zhiyi-Zhao/dsh-notify
```

The built artifacts (`lib/`) are committed, so no local toolchain is needed. pnpm may still require explicit approval for a git dependency's build script; if the command asks for that, add the key it prints to the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and retry:

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  dsh-notify: true
```

### Option 3: a local directory (development)

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-notify
```

The package declares both a `dsh.bundle` layer (which mounts the row) and a `dsh.client` browser half. After installing into the **desktop** profile, restart the DeepSeek Harness application: profile composition is read at startup, and the profile is owned by the Electron shell, so the CLI cannot reload it for you.

The first load after installation shows one self-test notification, so you can tell the channel works without waiting for a long task.

Uninstall:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-notify
```

## Noise control

Notifications default to *attention only*: nothing is shown while the window is focused and visible, a completed run shorter than 10 seconds is ignored, and one stopped agent produces one notification — a pending confirmation or an error replaces the "finished" notice for the same run.

Runtime tunables are read from `localStorage['dsh-notify.options']` as a JSON object. Client halves do not receive their `cordis.yml` row config (the Web boot kernel creates every entry with `loader.create({ name })`), so this key is the standalone plugin's configuration channel:

```js
localStorage.setItem('dsh-notify.options', JSON.stringify({ onlyWhenUnfocused: false, minRunMs: 0 }))
```

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `onlyWhenUnfocused` | `true` | Stay silent while the window is focused and visible |
| `minRunMs` | `10000` | Ignore completed runs shorter than this |
| `silent` | `false` | Show notifications without the platform sound |
| `selfTest` | `true` | Show the one-time installation notification |
| `replaceTurnEndMs` | `2000` | How long a turn-end notice waits for a better notice about the same run |

The self-test flag is `localStorage['dsh-notify.selfTestShown']`.

## How it runs

The plugin is a browser half only; the host half exists so a profile row can mount the package. Every notification is rendered by the page through the Web Notification API, which is why the plugin works in the desktop shell and in a plain browser window alike, and why it needs no packaging identity or PowerShell helper.

The desktop shell grants notification permission to its main window (only `media` requests are routed elsewhere), so toasts arrive without a prompt. A plain browser window needs one user gesture before it may ask; the plugin requests permission on the first pointer or keyboard event and stays silent until it is granted. Without a Web Notification API, or with permission denied, the plugin logs one warning and disables itself.

## Delivery and diagnosis

The first notification also registers the application under **Settings → System → Notifications** (Windows lists it as *DeepSeek Harness*). That entry is where to confirm banners are allowed, and the notification center (`Win+N`) is where a suppressed or missed banner still appears.

Nothing is shown while the window is focused and visible: that is the default `onlyWhenUnfocused` behaviour, not a failure. To check the channel itself, switch to another window and let a turn finish. When a notification is expected and absent, check in that order: the per-app switch in notification settings, the notification-center history, and `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Notifications\wpndatabase.db` for whether the system received it at all.

**Never pass `tag`.** Measured on this machine: a tagged `new Notification()` is accepted by the browser but the toast **never reaches Windows**, while the identical call without a tag arrives every time — the installation notification, the probes, and the real turn-end notice all confirm it. Per-session replacement is the price, so repeated notices in one session stack.

## Known limitations and deferred work

- **No `cordis.yml` options.** Client entries receive no config, so this plugin reads its tunables from `localStorage`. An upstream package should serve a host-side settings namespace and a settings card instead.
- **A reload during a run is compensated, not eliminated.** On activation the plugin seeds every session whose list row is already `running`, so the completion of a turn that was in flight still notifies. A client that does not project running state into its list leaves that turn unannounced.
- **No same-session replacement.** Notifications carry no `tag` (see above), so repeated notices stack instead of replacing each other.
- **Per-client delivery.** Two attached clients (desktop window plus a browser tab) each notify. Cross-client de-duplication has no owner today.
- **Web GUI only.** The plugin injects client services (`remote`, `sessions`, `locale`, plus optional `uiSession`); headless and ACP runs have no browser half and receive nothing.
- **A repeat run can re-notify a job.** A job whose row disappears from the mirror and later returns with the same id and status is suppressed only by identity, not by time.

## Activation safety

A client entry that throws fails the Web boot audit, and the desktop shell treats that audit failure as fatal: the application does not start, and its crash recovery rewrites the profile. Two mistakes here each caused exactly that on a live profile before they were fixed, so both are now rules of the implementation:

- **Resolve services once, at apply time.** `ctx.<service>` resolves against the running fiber, so a callback that runs outside this plugin's fiber — a store notification, a notification click, the deferral timer — must use a captured value. Reaching through `ctx` there throws `cannot get required service "sessions" in inactive context`.
- **Treat published state as partial.** The session-list store publishes states without `jobsBySession`; a rule that assumes the member exists throws `Cannot convert undefined or null to object` and fails activation.

`apply` additionally contains its whole activation: any unexpected error logs one line and turns notifications off instead of reaching the boot audit. Verify any change against a **separate profile**, never the one you are working in — `dsh --profile <scratch>` with its own `DSH_HOME` reproduces the real boot, and the browser console is where the underlying error appears.

## Client version compatibility

Three client members this plugin reads differ across DSH versions; the code accepts both (verified against the 0.2.0-rc.2 desktop build installed here):

| Signal | Current clients | O

plugins.description: Drive the user's real Google Chrome from DeepSeek Harness without CDP: native messaging + MV3 extension, numbered-text snapshots, persistent profile. 不走 Chrome 调试协议, 用扩展驱动本机 Chrome.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-browser

把 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 接到本机真实的 Google Chrome 上, **不使用 Chrome 调试协议**.

页面被转成带编号的文本清单交给模型操作, 不截图, 因此也不需要视觉模型. Chrome 用一个持久的独立 profile, 登录态与浏览历史跨会话保留.

## 为什么不走 CDP

Puppeteer / Playwright 一类工具挂上浏览器时会发出 `Runtime.enable`, 这个命令的副作用可以被页面里几行 JavaScript 探测到, 主流反爬厂商都在用这个信号 ([DataDome 的分析](https://datadome.co/threat-research/how-new-headless-chrome-the-cdp-signal-are-impacting-bot-detection/)). 加上 `navigator.webdriver` 和"全新空白 profile"这两个加分项, 结果就是频繁撞验证码.

本插件把这一整类特征摘掉:

| | 常见 CDP 方案 | 本插件 |
|---|---|---|
| 启动参数 | `--remote-debugging-port` / `--headless` | 只有 `--user-data-dir` 与两个跳过引导的开关 |
| 控制通道 | DevTools Protocol WebSocket | 浏览器扩展 + native messaging |
| Chrome 扩展 | 常被 `--disable-extensions` 关掉 | 可用, 而且**就是**控制通道 |
| profile | 每会话一个全新目录 | 一个持久目录, 登录态累积 |
| 页面与 harness 之间 | 调试协议 | Chrome 自己管理的 stdio 管道 |

**需要说清楚的边界**: 去掉 CDP 摘掉的是"检测到自动化工具"这一类特征. IP 信誉, UA 与指纹, 行为节奏这些都和 CDP 无关, 照旧可能让你遇到验证. 本插件不能承诺"绝对不弹验证".

## 它是怎么连起来的

```
真实的 Google Chrome
  └─ 扩展 (MV3)
       │ chrome.runtime.connectNative()      ← 没有端口, 没有 CDP
       ▼
     native messaging host (node 进程, 由 Chrome 按清单拉起)
       │ ws://127.0.0.1:<dsh 端口>/ext/bridge ← 地址与令牌从会合文件里读
       ▼
     dsh 插件 (注册 browser_* 工具)
       ▼
     Agent
```

关键在中间那一跳: 扩展**不需要知道 dsh 跑在哪个端口**. 它只说"启动我的 native host", Chrome 负责把进程拉起来并建立管道; host 则从 dsh 写下的会合文件里读到真实地址. 所以 dsh 换端口, 随机端口都不影响.

## 安装

### 1. 装插件

```shell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add azazo1/dsh-browser
```

或者从源码装:

```shell
git clone https://github.com/azazo1/dsh-browser
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-browser
```

装完重启 dsh.

### 2. 在配置页装连接组件

打开 **设置 -> 插件 -> dsh-browser**, 点 **安装连接组件**. 这一步做三件事:

- 把扩展产物复制到 dsh 的数据目录;
- 生成 native messaging 清单, 写上与本扩展公钥相符的扩展 id;
- 生成一个启动包装脚本, 里面写死 node 的绝对路径 (Chrome 直接 exec 它, 不经过 shell, 走不到 PATH).

清单写入用户目录, **不需要 root**:

| 平台 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| macOS | `~/Library/Application Support/Google/Chrome/NativeMessagingHosts/` |
| Linux | `~/.config/google-chrome/NativeMessagingHosts/` |
| Windows | 注册表 `HKCU\Software\Google\Chrome\NativeMessagingHosts\` |

### 3. 手动加载一次扩展

Chrome 从 33 起就只接受商店来源或企业策略强制的扩展, 命令行装载也在 Chrome 154 被禁掉 (`--load-extension is not allowed in Google Chrome`). 所以**这一步只能由你本人点**:

1. 打开 `chrome://extensions`, 右上角开启开发者模式;
2. 点"加载已解压的扩展程序";
3. 选中配置页上显示的那个扩展目录 (用页面上的复制按钮最省事);
4. 回到配置页, 状态会自动变绿.

用 `unpacked` 方式加载的扩展**没有自动更新**, 每次改扩展都要回 `chrome://extensions` 手动 reload. 想要零手工和自动更新, 就走 Chrome 应用商店 (见下面的"发布").

### 4. 配对令牌 (必需)

dsh 与扩展之间用一条配对令牌互相确认, 没配对之前浏览器操作会被拒绝.

1. 点浏览器工具栏上的 **dsh Browser** 图标, 打开弹出面板;
2. 面板里显示本扩展的**配对令牌**, 点「复制」;
3. 打开 dsh 的 **设置 -> 插件 -> dsh-browser**, 把令牌粘贴到配置页的**配对令牌输入框**并点「保存令牌」;
4. 扩展会自动重连 (最多等一个重连周期), 面板上的状态变成「dsh 已接受配对」.

令牌由扩展生成并存在它自己的存储里, 用户抄进 dsh —— 方向之所以是这样: 令牌要证明的是"连上来的是我认可的那个扩展", 而只有扩展侧能把它展示给人看.

保存时令牌直接写进数据目录下的 `pairing-token` 文件 (权限 0600), **不经过配置文件**: 令牌是每台设备各一份的凭据, 而配置文件常被整个纳入 git 在多台设备间同步, 不该带着令牌走. 数据目录默认是 `<DSH_HOME>/data/dsh-browser`, 不参与同步. 握手核对读的就是那个文件. 配置项 `pairingToken` 只为兼容保留: 老版本存进去的值会在插件启动或打开配置页时自动搬进令牌文件并清空.

在扩展面板里点「重新生成」可以换令牌, 换完必须把新的那个重新提交到配置页的令牌输入框.

> 没有令牌时不是"降级放行"而是**拒绝**: 静默接受一条没有身份的连接, 正是鉴权要避免的事.

### 5. (可选) 打开浏览器求值开关

`browser_evaluate` 需要在扩展详情页手动打开 **Allow User Scripts**:

1. 打开 `chrome://extensions`, 找到 dsh Browser, 点 **详情**;
2. 打开 **Allow User Scripts** 开关 (Chrome 138 之前是打开右上角的开发者模式);
3. 重新加载扩展.

为什么非开不可: 扩展页面与 ISOLATED world 的 CSP 是 `script-src 'self'`, 官方明确不允许追加
`'unsafe-eval'`, 所以 `new Function` 在那两个环境里被挡; `chrome.scripting.executeScript` 又只收函数
不收代码字符串. 只有 `chrome.userScripts` 的 `USER_SCRIPT` world 豁免页面 CSP 且接受代码字符串,
它的代价就是这个开关.

**不开也能用**: 其余 19 个工具不受影响, 只是 `browser_evaluate` 会明确告诉你开关没开, 并建议改用
`browser_query`. 配置页与 `browser_status` 都会显示这个开关的状态.

## 使用

装好之后, Agent 就有了这些工具:

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `browser_status` | 查询整条链路的状态与待办 |
| `browser_open` | 启动 (或复用) 持久 Chrome, 可顺带打开一个地址 |
| `browser_tabs` | 列出标签页 |
| `browser_select_tab` | 绑定一个标签页作为操作目标 |
| `browser_close_tab` | 关闭一个标签页 (自动清掉绑定; 拒绝关闭窗口里的最后一个) |
| `browser_snapshot` | 取页面结构: 元素编号清单 + 正文 |
| `browser_text` | 只取正文, 更省上下文 |
| `browser_click` / `browser_fill` | 按快照编号点击 / 填入 |
| `browser_press_key` | 发送按键 |
| `browser_scroll` | 滚动 (会报告是否到底) |
| `browser_navigate` | 跳转地址 |
| `browser_wait` | 等待页面出现指定文本 |
| `browser_query` | 按 CSS 选择器批量取数据 (文本 + 属性), 含隐藏元素 |
| `browser_hover` | 悬停到编号元素, 触发下拉菜单一类只认鼠标移入的界面 |
| `browser_upload` | 把本机文件装进 `input[type=file]`, 按选择器定位 (文件输入框通常是隐藏的) |
| `browser_screenshot` | 截当前视口存成图片文件并返回路径 |
| `browser_evaluate` | 在页面里执行 JS 表达式取回结果 (需要额外开关, 见下) |
| `browser_console` | 按需抓取绑定标签页的 console 输出与未捕获异常 (start / read / stop 三段式) |

工具之间的分工值得说清楚, 因为它们看起来有重叠:

- `browser_snapshot` 只列**可见的可交互元素**并给编号, 目的是**操作**; `browser_query` 返回**全部**
  匹配项的文本与属性, 目的是**读数**. 两者不共用过滤条件.
- `browser_text` 读整页正文; `browser_query` 取局部结构; `browser_evaluate` 算东西或读页面 JS 变量.
- `browser_screenshot` 只截**当前视口**, 而且**不把图片发给模型**: 它落成文件并返回路径. 能看图的
  模型接着用 `read_image` 读这个路径; 不能看图的模型把路径交给用户. 这样图片的限额, 缩放与
  模型能力判断都由 harness 已有的 `read_image` 负责, 插件不重复实现一遍.
- `browser_console` 是唯一走 `chrome.debugger` 的工具: 只在 start 与 stop 之间 attach, 期间浏览器
  顶部会出现"已开始调试此浏览器"提示条 (页面脚本检测不到, 但用户可见, 也可以点掉它强制中断).
  它只收集开始之后的输出, 不含历史.

两个使用上的要点:

- **页面操作只作用于被绑定的那个标签页.** 必须先 `browser_select_tab`. 这是有意的: 没有"跟随用户当前标签"这种隐式行为, 免得你在别的标签页上看东西时被改到.
- **快照编号会失效.** 页面一变, 上一次 `browser_snapshot` 的编号就不能用了, 工具会明确报错让你重新取, 而不是点到一个已经变了的元素上.

## 用哪个浏览器

默认**不自行启动 Chrome**, 只用扩展已经连上的那个浏览器 —— 也就是用户在自己日常 Chrome 里加载了扩展的那一个.
那份 profile 有用户的登录态, 也最不容易引起风控注意.

| launchStandaloneChromeProfile | 行为 |
|---|---|
| `false` (默认) | 永不自行打开 Chrome. 扩展没连上时, 工具会说明"请打开装了扩展的那个 Chrome" |
| `true` | dsh 用一份**全新的独立 profile** 启动 Chrome, **不复用**日常那个窗口. 那份 profile 里**不会**自动带上扩展, 需要单独加载一次 |

打开 `launchStandaloneChromeProfile` 的代价值得说清楚: 一份全新的 profile **没有**用户的登录态与历史, 而这套方案原本要避免的正是"看起来像个新环境". 这个开关可以在插件配置页直接拨.

## 没配好之前会发生什么

插件在**弹授权请求之前**先确认"有一条能真正用上的路". 没配好时:

- **不会弹 ask** —— 用户同意之后一样用不了, 那个弹窗纯粹是打扰;
- 工具直接返回**配置步骤**, 并要求模型讲给用户听, 而不是自己反复重试.

所以第一次用浏览器时, 模型会告诉你缺什么, 例如:

```
浏览器还没配置好, 所以现在不能操作浏览器, 也不会弹出授权请求.

还缺:
- dsh 侧还没填配对令牌

请把下面这些步骤讲给用户 ... 期间不要反复重试浏览器工具:
1. 打开 dsh 的「设置 -> 插件 -> dsh-browser」配置页, 点「安装连接组件」.
2. 在 Chrome 地址栏打开 chrome://extensions, ... 选择这个文件夹:
   <数据目录>/extension
3. 点浏览器工具栏上的 dsh Browser 图标, 复制里面的「配对令牌」, 填回 pairingToken.
```

`browser_status` 不需要配置好就能调用, 所以它是"先看看现在缺什么"的入口.

## 多个会话与浏览器驱动权

浏览器平面是**独占**的: 分发给扩展的持久 profile 只有一个, 扩展内部也只维持一个"当前绑定标签页".
两个会话同时驱动同一个浏览器会互相踩, 所以插件把它做成一份**可申请的驱动权**.

| 情况 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 会话第一次调用会占用浏览器的工具 | 弹一次审批, 由用户决定给不给 |
| 用户同意 | 该会话取得驱动权; 若原本在别人手上, 一并收回 |
| 同一会话继续调用 | 直接用, 不再询问 |
| 浏览器归别的会话 | 本会话调用时照样弹审批; 同意即可交过来, 对方之后的调用会重新申请 |
| 会话结束或被切走 | 驱动权自动回到无人持有 |
| `browser_release` | 主动交出, 不必等会话结束 |

会话页有一个「浏览器」Tab, 可以看清现在归谁, 并把驱动权交给本会话或从本会话释放.
那里的"获取"等于用户本人同意, 不会再弹审批; 链路还没配好时仍然会拒绝.

`browser_status` 不占用浏览器, 所以不需要申请 —— 它也是第二个会话在申请之前查看"现在归谁"的入口.

申请走的是 harness 标准的审批通道 (同一个应答者, 同样在会话日志里留 `approval/asked` 与
`approval/decided` 审计对), 所以它遵守会话的审批策略, 也可以被 `auto-review` 一类插件自动应答.

**没有审批通道时是拒绝而不是放行**: "静默取得浏览器"正是要避免的行为. 要在无人值守环境里用,
就显式把 `askOnAcquire` 关掉.

## 配置

在 profile 的 patch 层里按条目 id `dsh-browser` 覆盖:

```yaml
- id: dsh-browser
  config:
    # Chrome 可执行文件; 省略时按平台探测稳定版安装位置.
    chromePath: /Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome
    # 持久 profile 目录; 省略时用 <DSH_HOME>/data/dsh-browser/profile.
    profileDir: ~/chrome-for-dsh
    # 额外启动参数, 每项一个完整参数. 会破坏本插件前提的参数会被拒绝.
    extraArgs: []
    # 会话第一次使用浏览器前是否征求用户同意 (即"申请"). 默认开启.
    askOnAcquire: true
    # 是否启动 dsh 自己那份独立 profile 的 Chrome. 默认关闭.
    # 关闭时插件永远不会自行打开 Chrome, 只用扩展已经连上的那个浏览器.
    # 打开后不再复用日常那个 Chrome, 始终启动独立 profile.
    launchStandaloneChromeProfile: false
    # 与浏览器扩展配对的令牌; 正常流程不需要在这里填, 配置页的令牌输入框会直接把令牌
    # 写进数据目录. 这个字段只为兼容保留: 遗留值会被插件自动搬走并清空.
    pairingToken: ''
    # 是否自动同步连接组件与扩展产物到数据目录. 默认关闭; 也可在插件配置页用
    # "自动同步连接组件" 开关拨动.
    installHostAutomatically: false
```

`extraArgs` 会拒绝 `--remote-debugging-port`, `--headless`, `--disable-extensions`, `--user-data-dir` 等参数并在启动时报错: 它们与本插件的前提直接冲突, 静默接受会让"为什么又弹验证了"变得无从排查.

## 开发

```shell
just install     # 安装依赖
just verify      # 类型检查 + 构建 + 测试
just build       # 重建 lib/ 与 assets/extension
just test        # 只跑测试
just icons       # 重新生成扩展图标
just extension-id  # 打印扩展 id
```

```
src/
  index.ts          插件入口: 注册 provider, 工具, 系统提示, 审批
  c

plugins.description: DSH 输入框一键提示词增强按钮 | One-click prompt enhancement for the DeepSeek Harness composer: rewrite the unsent draft into a clearer, more specific prompt, restore the original with one click. Ported from Tencent WorkBuddy's EnhancePrompt design; independent model call that never touches the session log.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-prompt-optimization-master

**作者：Kirin（GitHub: [ruiyukirin](https://github.com/ruiyukirin)）**

给 DeepSeek Harness 的输入框加一个**提示词优化**按钮：点一下，把还没发出去的草稿
改写成更清晰、更具体的提示词；再点一下，还原原文。

机制参考腾讯 WorkBuddy 的 EnhancePrompt（增强提示词）功能。

[English →](README.en.md) ｜ [更新日志 →](CHANGELOG.md)

---

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ruiyukirin/dsh-prompt-optimization-master
```

也可以从 [Releases](https://github.com/ruiyukirin/dsh-prompt-optimization-master/releases) 下载 tarball（压缩包）安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "https://github.com/ruiyukirin/dsh-prompt-optimization-master/releases/download/v0.3.1/dsh-prompt-optimization-master-0.3.1.tgz"
```

> **升级提示**：0.3.1 修掉了"会思考的模型下一直转圈、没有产出"的问题
> （详见 [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md) 与下方「实测记录」）。用 0.3.0 的话请尽快升级。

> **关于名字**：`dsh-prompt-enhance` 与 `dsh-prompt-optimizer` 在 npm 和 GitHub 上都已被
> 他人占用（且是同一产品定位），所以本插件改用 `dsh-prompt-optimization-master`，
> 发布前已逐项核查 npm 与 GitHub 三处均无占用。

---

## 它能干什么

在输入框工具栏右侧（模型选择器与发送按钮之间）出现一个 ✨ 按钮：

| 状态 | 图标 | 点击效果 |
|---|---|---|
| 有草稿、空闲 | ✨ | 把草稿发给模型改写，结果直接替换输入框 |
| 优化中 | ⏳ | **取消**，中止请求并还原原文 |
| 已优化 | ↩️ | **恢复原文** |

- **输入了才出现**：草稿为空时按钮自动隐藏——和 WorkBuddy 一样。
  隐形占位符（零宽空格 `U+200B`）不算内容，不会被误判成"有输入"。
- **输入框忙的时候不出现**：输入框正在提交/仲裁（`submitting` / `adjudicating`）时隐藏，
  避免点出一个白跑的请求；但**已优化过的结果仍可还原**，不会被锁死。
- **改过就失效**：优化之后如果你又手动改了草稿，"恢复原文"会自动退休，
  不会把你后来的修改吞掉。
- **切会话自动复位**：切换会话后，上一个会话的备份与错误提示不会残留。
- **不占对话上下文**：优化走的是独立的模型调用，不创建会话、不写入会话记录，
  **也不读对话历史**——只看「固定提示词 + 当前草稿」。这一点与 WorkBuddy 一致。

---

## 效果

同一段草稿，点一下 ✨ 之后：

| 优化前 | 优化后 |
|---|---|
| ![优化前：草稿加 ✨ 按钮](docs/images/composer-before.png) | ![优化后：改写结果加 ↩ 还原按钮](docs/images/composer-after.png) |

草稿从「已经重启了，现在你检查一下任务的进度」被改写成一条目标明确、把要检查的几项
都点名的任务说明；右侧的 ✨ 同时变成了 ↶（还原原文）。

## 设置

**设置 → 提示词优化**——设置面板左侧栏里的一个独立条目，和「费用」「插件市场」「侧边卡片」并列：

| 项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **启用 ✨ 按钮** | 关掉后按钮从输入框消失。随时可以回到这一页重新打开 |
| **最少字符数** | 草稿短于这个长度就不显示按钮。留空 = 跟随宿主默认值 |
| **指定模型** | 默认跟随当前会话模型。勾选后可填提供方 provider 与模型 ID——**这个辅助调用能固定到便宜模型上，不影响你对话本身用哪个模型** |

![设置页：设置面板左侧栏里的「提示词优化」](docs/images/settings-page.png)

设置存在浏览器本地存储里，**重装插件不会丢**。

## 语言

按钮文案跟随 DSH 的界面语言（设置 → 语言），内置**简体中文与英文**两套。

走的是 DSH 官方 locale（本地化）服务，不是硬编码字符串。

---

## 工作原理

```
[输入框草稿]
    ↓ useInput(s => s.draft)
[✨ 按钮]（conversation.input.right 插槽）
    ↓ POST /dsh-prompt-enhance/enhance
[宿主半]  ctx.llm.stream({ system, messages })   ← 独立调用，不入会话
    ↓ 拼接 text-delta 分片
[写回输入框]  inputActions.setDraft(text)
    ＋ 原文存进备份，可一键还原
```

用的是插件自己的 HTTP 路由，不是 Remote。原因：桌面版界面跑在 `dsh-app://` 协议上，
Electron 会把非静态资源的路径**全部转发**给宿主 HTTP 服务，所以相对路径 `fetch` 是通的
——但转发函数强制要求请求头 `Origin: dsh-app://app`，宿主侧的同源校验必须显式接受它，
否则桌面版下会全部 403。

### 提示词设计

两层结构，沿用 WorkBuddy 的思路并做了适配：

1. **system** —— 角色设定：提示词工程专家，服务于一个通用的编码/操作型 AI 助手。
   明确列出该做什么、不该做什么（不许写教程、不许要代码片段、不许提用户没提的技术栈、
   不许回答问题而要把问题改得更精确）。
2. **user** —— 任务模板 + 少样本示例。核心是**语言锁定为最高优先级**，
   外加一组"坏输出 vs 好输出"对照，专门压制"用户输入是中文 → 应该用中文回复"
   这类元话术。

结果还会做清洗：剥掉模型爱加的 Markdown 围栏和首尾引号。

---

## 结构

| 路径 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `dsh/index.js` | 宿主半：路由、提示词、模型调用、取消与错误码 |
| `client/client.js` | 客户端半：三态按钮 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 装载该插件的一行 insert |
| `test/smoke.mjs` | 宿主半离线冒烟测试（45 项检查） |
| `test/client.test.mjs` | 客户端半状态机测试（57 项检查，沙箱里跑真实代码） |
| `test/reasoning-budget.mjs` | 输出预算回归测试（29 项检查：思考识别、上限封顶、截断重试、超时） |
| `docs/` | 调研报告：WorkBuddy 机制、命名诊断、机制对比、发布策略 |
| `docs/阶段0-探针结论.md` | 插槽契约实测记录 |

---

## 实测记录（都踩过）

下面这些不是推测，是在真机上验证/踩坑得来的：

| 发现 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **`ctx.llm` 不能直接访问** | Cordis 会抛 `cannot get property "llm" without inject`。必须用 `ctx.get('llm')` 或声明 `inject`。已修，并且冒烟测试现在会**模拟这个守卫**，防止回归。 |
| **推理会吃光输出预算** | 实测 `deepseek-flash`：一次短改写输出了 132 字符可见文本，但**推理花了 2632 字符**。512 token 的预算会全被推理吃掉、可见输出为 0。所以输出上限提到 4096，并把"触发上限"单独报成 `truncated`——截断的提示词比不优化更糟。 |
| **`setDraft` 是整体替换** | 官方源码注释：*Replace the whole draft; newline 分段；光标落到末尾*。 |
| **业务错误不能用 HTTP 状态判断** | 宿主的错误是 HTTP 200 + `ok:false`。客户端一度在这里提前清空了请求 id，导致 catch 把它当成"已被新请求取代"而直接返回——**模型一失败按钮就永久转圈**。已修，客户端测试锁死。 |
| **桌面版 Origin 是 `dsh-app://app`** | Electron 会把非静态资源路径全部转发给宿主 HTTP 服务，但强制要求这个 Origin。严格同源校验在桌面版会全部 403。 |
| **零宽空格会被误判成"有输入"** | 编辑器会塞入隐形占位符 `U+200B`，而 `trim()` 不会去掉它。WorkBuddy 会先剔除再计数；本插件原先没剔，导致草稿"看起来是空的"却能点按钮并发出无意义请求。已修（含测试）。 |
| **照搬提示词时会漏条款** | 双层提示词里，`TASK_PROMPT` 是 WorkBuddy 的逐字照搬（字符级只差 4 处），但 `SYSTEM_PROMPT` 漏了「约 800 字符」的长度上限和 2 组英文少样本——没有上限，模型会把一行需求写成多段小作文。已补回。 |
| **写死输出预算会被"思考型"模型打穿** | 实测 `hy4-preview`（`onlyReasoning: true`、`canDisableThinking: false`）：固定 4096 token 会**全部被推理吃掉**，可见输出 0 字，最后报 `truncated`；连「你好」两个字都要耗 89～114 秒才失败，界面表现就是**一直转圈没有产出**。同一份代码换成 `deepseek-v4.1-flash` 只要 1.7 秒就成功——**这是模型相关的失败，不是插件坏掉**。修法：输出预算按模型是否思考动态分配（思考型 32768 / 普通 4096），用官方 `ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo()` 判断（看 `reasoning.efforts` 是否只有 `off` 一档），并按模型自身的 `defaultMaxTokens` 封顶。**不要写死模型名单。** |
| **宿主侧没有超时会永远转圈** | 模型慢或卡住时，客户端没有任何反馈。已加 60 秒硬超时，报 `timeout`；被判定为"不思考"却仍截断的，自动用大额度**重试一次**（两次共享同一个总时限）。 |
| **能力查询不能放在调用链上白等** | `resolveModelInfo()` 卡住时，原先会白等守卫时间。现已：结果按路线缓存（放在插件实例内，不用模块级全局）、守卫降到 1.2 秒、查询失败会记住，靠"截断重试"兜底。 |

## 开发时的两个硬约束（实测，不是猜的）

- **客户端半改动 → 刷新页面。** HMR 只在模块首次加入模块图时推送一次，之后的改动不会自动推。
- **宿主半改动 → 重启 DSH。** Loader 会把插件模块缓存在进程里。以下三种方式都实测过，
  都不会重新导入模块：禁用/启用插件、重新应用 bundle、改写 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`。

所以调这个插件时，客户端改动刷新即可，宿主改动要重启一次。

### 离线测试

```bash
npm test        # 不需要 DSH，三套测试一起跑
```

- **宿主半**（`test/smoke.mjs`）：假 Cordis ctx + 真 HTTP 服务，覆盖路由注册、请求守卫
  （含 `dsh-app://app` 源）、提示词组装、分片累积、结果清洗、全部错误码、取消、
  以及 llm 服务缺席。
- **客户端半**（`test/client.test.mjs`）：用 `node:vm` 把真实的 `client/client.js`
  跑起来，配一个极简 React 与假 fetch，驱动按钮走完全部状态转换——空草稿隐藏、
  增强、还原、取消、失败还原、宿主未加载提示，以及"手动改动后备份失效"。
- **输出预算**（`test/reasoning-budget.mjs`）：锁死"思考型模型打穿额度"这个坑——
  额度是否跟随模型能力、模型自身上限是否封顶、卡住的查询会不会拖慢改写、
  截断是否重试、无效重试是否被抑制。真实的 60 秒超时是**按需跑**的，因为它会
  拖长整个测试：

  ```bash
  DSH_PE_SLOW_TESTS=1 node test/reasoning-budget.mjs
  ```

### 无头调试技巧

拿不到浏览器控制台时，可以让客户端把数据写进 `localStorage`，再从磁盘上的 leveldb 读：

```
C:\Users\yuqil\AppData\Roaming\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\Local Storage\leveldb
```

`.wb-research/read-ls.mjs` 是配套的取值脚本。

> ⚠️ 注意：**不要用 shell 的 `Get-Content` / `WriteAllText` 改写 `cordis.patch.yml`**。
> Windows PowerShell 会按 ANSI 解码无 BOM 的 UTF-8 文件，一读一写就把中文注释变成乱码，
> 还可能吃掉换行导致 YAML 解析失败。要改就用能保证 UTF-8 的编辑工具。

## 许可

MIT
