plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-manim-card

给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个能力：**AI 在聊天里直接写 Manim 代码，当场在聊天流里出现一张可播放的动画卡片**——能播放、能查看代码。

代码在浏览器内执行，运行资源随插件分发，**本机不需要安装 Python**，也不依赖任何外部服务。

![聊天流中的 Manim 动画卡片：标题行、画布，右侧三个按钮](docs/shots/card-preview.png)

> 线上文档（安装 / 在聊天里用 / 设置面板，中英双语）：<https://snowowowo.github.io/dsh-manim-card/>

## 特点

- **卡片就长在聊天流里**：一行标题、一块画布，右侧两个按钮——播放 / 查看代码。播放完停在终态画面，不会自己重来。
- **先预检，再呈现**：代码返回前先在真解释器里跑一遍，语法错与不支持的写法当场回给模型、同一回合修正，聊天里不会留下空白或残缺的卡片。
- **不要求本机 Python**：执行在浏览器内完成，运行资源随插件分发。
- **播放有分寸**：只有刚生成的那张卡真播一遍；重新挂载与旧会话里的卡一律直接落终态。手动播放一键压过全部自动规则。

## 安装

在宿主的插件管理里：

```
dsh plugin add github:snowowowo/dsh-manim-card
```

装完刷新宿主页面，设置里出现「Manim卡片」一节。首次渲染需要取一次运行资源（约 13 MB），之后离线可用。

## 用起来

在会话里说一句「用 Manim 画一个单位圆」，卡片随即出现在聊天流中。更多细节见文档站的[在聊天里用](https://snowowowo.github.io/dsh-manim-card/guide/usage)。

## 开发

技术栈、目录结构、开发流程与测试分工见文档站的[开发与调试](https://snowowowo.github.io/dsh-manim-card/dev/)。

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build      # 产出 client.js
pnpm test       # 单测（不联网那一档）
pnpm docs       # 本地起文档站
```

## 许可

本项目依 **MIT** 授权，全文见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。

随包分发的运行资源与构建产物内联的第三方组件，各依其自身许可——清单见 [THIRD-PARTY.md](./THIRD-PARTY.md)。

plugins.description: Markdown Studio - DeepSeek Harness 原生右侧 Markdown 预览插件：Mermaid 图表 · KaTeX 公式 · 代码高亮，渲染引擎随包内置完全离线 / Native DSH sidebar preview with offline Mermaid, KaTeX and highlighting
plugins.readme_text:
# 📄 Markdown Studio for DeepSeek Harness **在 DSH 原生右侧文件预览中，把 Markdown 里的 Mermaid 图表、数学公式、代码高亮一次看全。** 渲染引擎随插件内置，**完全离线可用** · 无需改动你的文档 · 停用即恢复官方渲染器 [![CI](https://github.com/BioAIEvolu/dsh-md-studio/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/BioAIEvolu/dsh-md-studio/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-md-studio)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-md-studio) [![Awesome DSH Plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com) [![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/BioAIEvolu/dsh-md-studio)](https://github.com/BioAIEvolu/dsh-md-studio/releases) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.0--rc.2-blue)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [![English](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-English-green)](README.en.md) [同一份 Mermaid 代码块：官方预览 vs Markdown Studio](docs/images/before-after.png)
--- ## 为什么需要它 DeepSeek Harness 的右侧文件预览很好用，但 **Mermaid 代码块只会显示为一堆源码**——架构图、时序图、流程图全都要靠想象。外部方案要么需要开独立面板、要么依赖 CDN 联网。 **Markdown Studio 直接接管原生预览的 Markdown 渲染器**：文件读取、权限校验、刷新、标签页这些全部保留 DSH 原生行为，只有"画"的部分被增强。渲染引擎（Mermaid / markdown-it / KaTeX / highlight.js / DOMPurify）**随插件打包**，断网也能看图。 | 官方预览 | Markdown Studio | |---|---| | `​```mermaid` 显示为代码块 | 就地渲染为 SVG 图 + 工具栏 | | 长文档来回滚动 | 图文混排，所见即所得 | ## ✨ 特性 - **📈 对话内 + 文档预览双渲染**：聊天消息里的 Mermaid 块与右侧打开的 Markdown 文档，用同一套管线就地渲染成 SVG 图 - **📈 Mermaid 图表**：流程图、时序图、甘特图、饼图等 Mermaid 11 全系图型；每张图带 **图形/源码切换 · 全屏（缩放/拖拽）· 下载 SVG** 工具栏；深浅主题自动重绘 - **🩹 语法自动修复**：真实文档里最常见的 `W2[Codex / Claude Code (ACP)]` 这类"标签含英文括号"语法错误，**自动修复后照常渲染**，并在徽章标注"已自动修复"——不用改你的文档 - **📐 KaTeX 数学公式**：行内 `$...$` 与块级 `$$...$$`（文档预览） - **📝 完整 GFM**：表格、任务列表、脚注、删除线、标题锚点跳转 - **🎨 代码高亮**：highlight.js 常用语言集 - **🖼️ 本地图片**：相对路径按文档目录解析，经 DSH 原生鉴权接口读取 - **📴 完全离线**：渲染零网络请求（有自动化测试断言兜底）；作者写在文档里的远程图片仍按原 URL 加载 - **🛡️ 安全**：DOMPurify 双重净化（文档 HTML + 图表 SVG），禁执行脚本；Mermaid `strict` 模式 ## 📸 截图 | 深色主题 | | |---|---| | ![深色主题完整渲染](docs/images/demo-dark.png) | ![浅色主题完整渲染](docs/images/demo-light.png) | | 深色 | 浅色 | ## 🚀 安装 > 需要 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2+`（客户端插槽 API 依赖，见 [兼容性](#️-兼容性)） **方式一 · 可视化插件市场（dshmarket）** 在 DSH 设置 → 插件 → 市场中搜索 `dsh-md-studio`。 **方式二 · 命令行（GitHub）** ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:BioAIEvolu/dsh-md-studio ``` **方式三 · 命令行（npm，发布后可用）** ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-md-studio ``` 安装后重启 DSH Desktop，在右侧打开任意 `.md` 文件即可。 ## 📖 使用 打开 Markdown 文件后： - 文档顶部出现 **Markdown Studio** 标识与 **查看源码** 按钮（整篇源码/渲染视图切换） - 每个 Mermaid 图表自带工具栏：**图形 / 源码 / 全屏 / 下载 SVG** - 全屏模式支持滚轮缩放、拖拽平移、一键适应 - 语法错误的图表保留源码并给出原因，**不影响文档里其他图表** - 不想用了？在插件管理中停用，官方渲染器原样恢复 试试仓库里的 [docs/demo.md](docs/demo.md)——一份覆盖全部特性的验证文档。 ## 🧠 工作原理 不扫描页面 DOM、不开独立窗口，而是注册 DSH 文档预览的**官方扩展插槽**，以更高优先级接管官方 Markdown 渲染键： ```mermaid flowchart LR A[打开 .md 文件] --> B[DSH 原生文件预览] B --> C{document slot} C -->|Markdown Studio 接管| D[本插件渲染器] C -->|其他类型保持官方| E[PDF / 图片 / Excel / 代码] D --> F[markdown-it + GFM] D --> G[Mermaid 图表] D --> H[KaTeX 公式] F --> I[DOMPurify 净化] G --> I I --> O[右侧标签页渲染] ``` - 文件读取、分页、刷新、生命周期仍由 DSH 管理——插件只负责"画" - 通过实时 Inspect 验证插槽注册：本插件 `active: true`，官方 Markdown 渲染器自动让位 ## ✅ 质量保障 `node test/browser.mjs` 加载与发布完全一致的 bundle，在真实 Chromium 中断网验证（**零网络请求、零页面异常** 断言）： | 验证项 | | |---|---| | Mermaid 四类图渲染 + 节点文字可见 | ✅ | | 含括号标签自动修复 | ✅ | | GFM 表格 / 任务列表 / 脚注 | ✅ | | 行内 + 块级 KaTeX | ✅ | | 代码高亮 | ✅ | | 图形/源码切换、全屏、SVG 下载 | ✅ | | 深浅主题重绘 | ✅ | | 非法图表隔离（一图坏不拖累整页） | ✅ | | XSS 净化（脚本不执行） | ✅ | | 快速切换文件无陈旧渲染 | ✅ | | 卸载清理 | ✅ | ## ⚠️ 兼容性 - 适配 **DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`**（`engines.dsh: >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`）；其他版本未验证，升级 DSH 后如插槽 API 变更请提 issue - 文档上限 200 万字符；单图 5 万字符 / 2000 行 / 2000 边 - Mermaid 输出经净化：图表内的交互点击、外部图片引用会被禁用 ## 🛠️ 从源码构建 ```sh pnpm install --ignore-scripts node scripts/build.mjs # 产出 lib/（含字体与三方授权清单） node test/browser.mjs # 真实浏览器测试 node test/screenshots.mjs # 重新生成文档截图 pnpm pack # 打包 dsh-md-studio-x.y.z.tgz ``` 构建产物 `lib/client.js` 为 DSH ModuleLoader 工厂格式，仅依赖宿主 React，其余依赖全部打包。 ## 🗺️ Roadmap - [x] 对话内 Mermaid 渲染（v1.2 已实现；与 [dsh-mermaid](https://github.com/MrmoLabs/dsh-mermaid) 插件共存安全，互不双渲染） - [ ] 图表导出 PNG - [ ] 目录（TOC）侧栏 - [ ] 设置页（字号、图表方向） ## 🙏 致谢 - [dsh-mermaid](https://github.com/MrmoLabs/dsh-mermaid)（MrmoLabs）与 [dsh-artifact-preview](https://github.com/nirvanaslash/dsh-artifact-preview)（nirvanaslash）——1.0 版的整合来源，1.1 的交互设计参考 - 渲染库：[Mermaid](https://mermaid.js.org/) · [markdown-it](https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it) · [DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify) · [highlight.js](https://highlightjs.org/) · [KaTeX](https://katex.org/)，完整授权见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) ## ⭐ 支持项目 如果这个插件帮你省掉了"改文档语法"和"切窗口看图"的时间，欢迎点个 Star；问题与需求请提 [Issue](https://github.com/BioAIEvolu/dsh-md-studio/issues)，PR 欢迎。 English documentation: [README.en.md](README.en.md) ## License [MIT](LICENSE) © BioAIEvolu

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的悬浮主题挂件：切换官方外观 + 自定义背景（图片/纯色）
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-theme-button 给 **DeepSeek Harness** 桌面版加一个悬浮主题挂件：切换官方外观，以及设置一层自定义背景。 挂件浮在界面之上，可以拖到任何位置并记住位置。所有界面自带半透明毛玻璃效果。 ## 效果展示 | 自定义背景：关闭 | 自定义背景：纯色 | | --- | --- | | | | | 自绘取色器 | 自定义背景：图片 | | --- | --- | | | | 面板、挂件、取色板都是半透明毛玻璃，只在自定义背景开启时生效。 ## 功能 | 功能 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | 悬浮挂件 | 默认在右下角，可拖动；位置自动记住；轻点开关面板，拖动时自动收起面板 | | 官方外观 | 浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统，写回 DSH 官方外观设置，不是插件自己的一套 | | 自定义背景 | 纯色（6 个预设 + 自绘取色器）或图片（最多 6 张），二选一 | | 背景参数 | 不透明度、模糊、亮度、饱和度，图片与纯色各有独立的不透明度 | | 适配方式 | 填充 / 适应 / 平铺 / 拉伸 | | 毛玻璃 | 挂件、面板、取色板三者一致；关闭自定义背景即恢复 DSH 原生外观 | ## 环境要求 - DeepSeek Harness 桌面版（Windows） - 无需额外依赖 ## 安装 先取得插件文件，再让 DSH 加载它。 ### 方式一：本地链接安装（推荐） 把插件文件夹放到一个**固定的位置**（装好后不要再移动），然后执行： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:C:\dsh-plugins\dsh-theme-button ``` ### 方式二：从发布包安装 1. 解压发布包到一个固定位置，例如 `C:\dsh-plugins\dsh-theme-button` 2. 在该目录下运行： ```powershell .\install.ps1 ``` 或者手工执行上面那条 `dsh plugin ... add link:` 命令。 ### 完成后必须重启 **请完全退出并重新启动 DSH。** 插件的宿主部分只在启动时加载，仅刷新页面不够。 ### 验证安装成功 重启后应该看到右下角出现一个调色板图标按钮。也可以访问： - `http://127.0.0.1:/dsh-theme-button/version` —— 应返回一个版本号 ## 使用方法 ### 挂件 | 操作 | 效果 | | --- | --- | | 轻点 | 打开 / 关闭设置面板 | | 按住拖动 | 移动挂件位置，鼠标变为抓手，面板自动收起；松手后位置自动保存 | | 位置 | 重开 DSH 后保持上次位置；不会超出屏幕，也不会进入窗口按钮那一行 | ### 官方外观 面板第一段是「外观」，三选一：浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统。选择会同步到 DSH 官方外观设置，与官方设置页双向一致。 ### 自定义背景 面板第二段是「自定义背景」，总开关默认**关闭**。 打开总开关后，选择背景来源： - **纯色**：点色板里的预设，或点最右边的方块打开取色器自定义 - **图片**：点「添加图片」选图，最多 6 张；点缩略图切换，点缩略图上的 × 删除 图片放满 6 张后，「添加图片」会自动变灰禁用；删掉一张即恢复。 ### 取色器 | 操作 | 效果 | | --- | --- | | 上方方形区域 | 拖动手柄调整饱和度与明度 | | 中间彩色条 | 拖动手柄调整色相，圆环中显示当前选中的颜色 | | 底部输入框 | 手动输入颜色值，回车或点击别处即生效 | | ▴ ▾ 按钮 | 在 HEX / RGB / HSL 三种格式之间切换 | 输入时三种格式都认：即使当前显示的是 HEX，直接输入 `rgb(255, 0, 0)` 也会按 RGB 解析。 ### 参数说明 | 参数 | 范围 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | 不透明度（图片） | 0–10 | 图片的显示强度，0 等于关闭整个效果 | | 不透明度（纯色） | 0–10 | 纯色独立的一份，与图片那份互不影响 | | 模糊 | 0–24px | 背景的模糊程度，默认 0 | | 亮度 | 0–10 | 5 为 100%，即不做调整 | | 饱和度 | 0–10 | 5 为 100%，即不做调整 | ### 适配方式 | 方式 | 效果 | | --- | --- | | 填充 | 铺满整个区域，超出部分裁掉（默认） | | 适应 | 完整显示整张图，可能留边 | | 平铺 | 按原尺寸重复平铺 | | 拉伸 | 拉伸到铺满，会变形 | ## 首次安装的默认值 | 项目 | 默认值 | | --- | --- | | 挂件位置 | 右下角 | | 外观 | 跟随系统 | | 自定义背景 | 关闭 | | 背景来源 | 未选择 | | 取色器颜色 | `#8FB3A5` | | 图片 | 无 | | 适配方式 | 填充 | | 不透明度 | 5 / 10 | | 模糊 | 0px | | 亮度 / 饱和度 | 5 / 10（100%） | 设置保存在本机浏览器存储中，重开 DSH 后全部沿用（面板的开 / 关状态除外）。 ## 卸载 ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-theme-button ``` 然后重启 DSH。如果还要清掉本机保存的设置，见「常见问题」最后一条。 ## 常见问题 **挂件没有出现** 确认已经**完全重启** DSH，而不是只刷新页面。再访问 `/dsh-theme-button/version` 看是否返回版本号。 **背景效果看不见** 先确认「自定义背景」总开关是打开的，且不透明度不为 0。 **侧边栏 / 某个区域没有效果** 少数情况下背景层需要界面自身发生变化才会重新计算。切换一下图片或颜色，或打开一个新会话即可恢复。 **改了插件文件没有生效** `lib/client.js`（界面部分）会自动重载，但同一版本 10 秒内最多重载 3 次，超过请手动刷新页面。`lib/index.js`（宿主部分）必须重启 DSH。 **想恢复出厂设置** 打开开发者工具，执行下面这行后刷新页面： ```js localStorage.removeItem('dsh-theme-button.state.v2') ``` ## 反馈问题 **这个项目不保证持续更新**，所以反馈的意义不是"让我去改"，而是**把问题记录下来**： 让后来遇到同样情况的人能在这里搜到答案，也让将来想接手的人知道有哪些坑。 所以无论你只是想说一句"这里好像不对"，还是发现了具体的 Bug，都欢迎告诉我： | 请提供 | 在哪看 | | --- | --- | | 你做了什么操作 | 越具体越好 | | 期望的结果 / 实际的结果 | 分别是什么 | | 插件版本 | `package.json` 里的 `version`，或访问 `/dsh-theme-button/version` | | DSH 版本 | DSH 的「关于」页 | | 截图 | 最有效，能省很多来回 | **联系方式** - **邮箱：`zhanghz1130@outlook.com`**（标题里带上 `dsh-theme-button`，方便我归档） - **GitHub Issues**：[提交 Issue](../../../issues) —— 推荐用这个，问题公开留存，别人能直接看到 **我不承诺一定会修**，但会尽量看一眼。如果问题只影响你的个别情况，也欢迎自行修改—— MIT 许可，随便改、随便发。 ## 已知限制 - 只支持 Windows 桌面版 DSH（边框预留区的处理依赖 Windows 窗口变量） - 取色器与面板都绘制在自己的浮层里，不会与 DSH 原生菜单抢占最上层：DSH 自己的菜单和对话框会盖住它们 - 图片上限 6 张，且受浏览器存储容量限制 ## 项目文件 | 文件 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `package.json` | 插件清单 | | `cordis.patch.yml` | 让 DSH 在启动时加载本插件 | | `lib/index.js` | 宿主部分：注册路由、注入页面脚本、读写外观偏好 | | `lib/client.js` | 界面部分：挂件、面板、取色器、背景效果 | | `install.ps1` | 安装辅助脚本 | | `LICENSE` | 许可协议 | `_dev/` 是开发资料（历史备份与补丁脚本），不参与分发，可以删除。 ## 开发 ```powershell # 打包：只收集该分发的文件，输出到 dist/ .\pack.ps1 ``` 改完 `lib/client.js` 后页面会自动重载（它每 2.5 秒检查一次版本号）；改完 `lib/index.js` 需要重启 DSH。 代码里有较多注释，说明了每一处设计的取舍；遇到疑问也欢迎直接[反馈](#反馈问题)。 ## 关于这个项目 这个插件是**用 AI 辅助完成的**。我本人不是程序员，没有独立写出这些代码的技术能力， 但我投入了大量时间去提需求、试效果、找问题、反复验证，也承担了 AI 开发工具的费用。 > **项目状态**：功能已完整可用。我**不承诺持续更新**——它现在够用，我就不一定继续折腾了。 > 代码是 MIT 许可，任何人都可以自己改、自己发。 如果你觉得它好用，欢迎请我喝杯水。感谢你的支持！ ### 感谢支持 --- ## 许可 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: Balance and per-session spend HUD for DeepSeek Harness, with budget alerts, peak-hour warnings and opt-in official price sync.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# dsh-balance-hud

An always-on HUD in the bottom-right corner of the **DSH (DeepSeek Harness)** Web GUI that shows your
DeepSeek **account balance** and the **cost of the current session**.

[简体中文说明](README.zh-CN.md) · [Design notes](docs/DESIGN.md) · [设计说明](docs/DESIGN.zh-CN.md) · [LICENSE](LICENSE)

![The two states of the HUD: a collapsed corner badge and the expanded detail panel](assets/preview-en.png)

> **About these images:** they are not photographs of a live DSH window. They are renders of the
> plugin's own layout and colours, driven by its real style values and real figures — a capture tool
> for the running GUI was not available when they were made. Treat them as a faithful layout
> reference, not as evidence of a running install. Pull requests replacing them with genuine
> screenshots are welcome.

- **Account balance** — recharge balance + bonus balance, read through the same service the
  *Settings → Account & balance* page uses (`ctx.deepseekAccount.getBalance()`).
- **Two cost figures** — a token-based *estimate* from the official price table, and an *actual*
  figure accumulated from real balance decreases (external reductions excluded).
- **External balance changes, both ways** — a top-up raises the balance, and a lapsed bonus grant is
  reclaimed by the platform; money moving in or out externally never touches the spending counter.
- **Per session** — the tracker is keyed by session id; refreshing the page or switching sessions
  never damages or clobbers another session's record, because the read → modify → write round trip
  is lossless.
- **No credentials, and no outbound network unless you opt in** — the plugin never touches your API
  key. It reaches the network only after you turn price syncing on (see
  [Prices and syncing](#prices-and-syncing)); until then it makes zero external requests.
- **Two halves, one relay** — a browser half renders the HUD; a Host half exposes read-only loopback
  HTTP routes (balance, bonus signal, price sync, model list), so the browser itself never talks to
  anything but loopback.
- **Configurable, and budgeted** — a preference row in *Settings → General* sets the model, the poll
  intervals, the budgets and the warnings; the card gains a coloured edge as spending approaches a
  budget, and the panel counts down to the next peak/off-peak switch.

```bash
# Windows — double-click tools\install.cmd, or:
tools\install.cmd

# macOS / Linux:
sh tools/install.sh
```

Both launchers find Node for you — including **the runtime DSH already ships**, which is not on
`PATH`. If your machine has no Node at all, they say so and tell you what to do, instead of failing
with `node: command not found`. Install into a different profile with `--profile <dir>`, preview with
`--dry-run`, undo with `--uninstall`.

Prefer to run it yourself? The plain form assumes Node is on `PATH`:

```bash
node tools/install.mjs    # install into ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop, then restart DSH
node tools/smoke.mjs      # offline smoke suite (83 assertions), no DSH install needed
```

**Then restart DSH.** Adding a plugin changes the profile's bundle list, which is not hot-reloaded;
a page refresh alone will not pick it up.

## The HUD

```text
                                                        ┌──────────────────────────────┐
                                                        │  Balance             ¥43.42  │
                                                        │  Session est.         ¥0.59  │
                                                        └──────────────────────────────┘
```

Hovering the card expands a detail panel: balance rows (recharge / bonus / total), the three priced
components of the estimate, the actual figure, token counts, and — with parallel sessions — the
apportionment rows (`Session share`, `Other sessions`, `Tracked sessions`, `Account total`). The
panel uses 4 decimals; the card uses 2. The interface ships in **Chinese and English** and follows
DSH's language by default; the English names below are what each row means.

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Balance | Total account balance (recharge + bonus), 2 decimals |
| Session est. | Estimate for the current session; 2 decimals on the card, 4 in the panel; `—` when the session has no token usage yet |
| Actual charged | Accumulated real spending for this session (single session; becomes `Session share` when parallel) |

Amounts below the smallest displayed unit render as `<¥0.01` on the card and `<¥0.0001` in the
panel, so real spending is never rounded down to a flat zero.

## Interaction

- **Hover** the card and the detail panel expands; move away and it closes.
- The card and the panel are separate elements with an intentional **8 px gap** between them, and the
  pointer must be able to cross that gap without the panel closing. The hover decision is attached to
  the card and the panel themselves — each has its own enter/leave handler — never to the enclosing
  positioning container. A **140 ms** pending-close timer carries the card's `mouseleave` across the
  gap so the panel's `mouseenter` cancels it.
- Leaving the **left** edge of the card *or* the **left** edge of the panel closes the panel. This is
  deliberate: the container reserves extra space above and to the sides, so hanging the close
  behaviour on the container box would keep the panel open over dead space.
- **Click** the card to fold it down to a small corner badge showing 2 cells — label and balance;
  click again to restore it.
- **Keyboard:** the card is a `role="button"` with `tabIndex=0` and toggles the fold on `Enter` and
  `Space`. The panel is a `role="dialog"`.
- The panel header carries a **Refresh** button that immediately shows a busy label and then an
  `Updated at HH:MM:SS` timestamp, plus the manual *I just topped up* button, which shows a querying
  state while it works.
- **There are deliberately no `title` attributes anywhere in the HUD.** A native browser tooltip
  appears as an opaque black box about a second after hover and covers the panel, so the summary
  lives in `aria-label` instead — asserted by the smoke suite as a regression guard.

## Settings

The plugin contributes **one preference row** — `余额与花费 HUD` — to the DSH slot
`settings.general.item`, which DSH declares as *"one preference row inside the General section — the
additive seat for a single setting that needs no page of its own"* (a whole page is
`settings.section`; the same slot carries DSH's own Language, link-opening and performance-usage
rows). Find it at **Settings → General → 余额与花费 HUD**. It does **not** take over a whole settings
page.

| Setting | Values | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Model (`计价模型`) | `deepseek-flash`, `deepseek-v4-pro` | `deepseek-flash` | Price table used for the estimate and the apportionment weights |
| Price auto-sync interval (`自动同步价格`) | off / 6 h / 24 h / 3 d / 7 d | off | Auto-sync cadence for the official price table; nothing runs until you pick one (see [Prices and syncing](#prices-and-syncing)) |
| Foreground poll interval (`前台刷新间隔`) | 30 / 60 / 120 / 300 s | 60 s | Balance poll cadence while the page is visible |
| Hidden interval (`后台（页面隐藏）`) | 30 / 60 / 120 / 300 s | 300 s | Balance poll cadence while the page is hidden |
| Peak-warning lead time (`峰前提醒`) | 5 / 10 / 15 / 30 min | 10 min | How early the peak/off-peak warning appears |
| Session budget (`本会话预算（元）`) | CNY, `0` = unset | 0 | Budget for this session's estimated spend |
| Daily budget (`每日预算（元）`) | CNY, `0` = unset | 0 | Budget for the Beijing-day confirmed spend |
| Show account total row (`显示账户级合计`) | on / off | on | `Account total` row in the panel when parallel sessions exist |
| Peak warnings (`峰时提醒`) | on / off | on | The peak/off-peak warning line in the panel |
| System notification on budget breach (`预算超限发系统通知`) | on / off | off | Optional `Notification` when a budget level is first reached |

The shipped row is labelled in Chinese; the English names above are what each control means.

**Persistence.** The row writes the `localStorage` key `dsh-balance-hud:settings:v1` — deliberately
**separate** from the accounti

plugins.description: Agent 体检诊所 —— 用可复核证据诊断 Agent 使用体验问题
plugins.readme_text:
# agent-clinic · Agent 体检诊所

**装为 Skill**（一行命令，无需克隆、无需选位置、无需回答任何提问）：

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1687210989/agent-clinic/main/install.sh | bash
```

**装为 DSH 插件**（侧边栏 → **插件** → **添加插件**，粘贴下面这行）：

```bash
https://github.com/1687210989/agent-clinic.git
```

> 装成插件后有侧边栏「🩺 体检」入口和全页面板。**装完必须完全退出并重启 Harness**——插件只在启动时装载。

> **你的 Agent 体检诊所。** 只读扫描本地 Agent 会话，用**可逐条复核的证据**诊断真实发生的使用体验问题（token 浪费、死循环、跨会话失忆、资产闲置），并为每个问题开出可执行的处方。

[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.15-blue)]()
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)]()
[![smoke](https://img.shields.io/badge/smoke-345%2F345-brightgreen)]()
[![CI](https://github.com/1687210989/agent-clinic/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/1687210989/agent-clinic/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> `smoke N/N` 是**本地自检的通过数**（由 smoke 自己在跑完后核对，数字对不上就以退出码 1 结束）——
> 想知道 CI 此刻是红是绿，看旁边那枚 **CI** 徽章（它就是 GitHub Actions 的实况，改不了）。

---

## 它解决什么问题

大多数 Agent 使用分析工具只给你一堆统计数字，你看完也不知道该干什么。

agent-clinic 的做法不同：**它给证据，也给处方。**

- 不只说"你有死循环"，而是说"10 月 8 日这个会话，`list_agents` 用同样的参数失败了 4 次，在 `session.v4.jsonl.zstd#L101-L108`"——一条命令你就能自己复核。
- 不只给建议，而是给**可执行的动作**：能整段粘进 profile 的 YAML 片段、斜杠命令、已核实插件的安装入口，或明确说没有插件能解。
- **读你的真实配置**再开口：处方会说"你现在 `maxInlineTokens=12500`（随附默认，profile 未覆盖）→ 建议 6000"，而不是"建议调低一点"。当前值已经不弱于建议时，这条处方会被撤掉 —— **而且会写出来**（报告里的「已评估但未给出的处方」段会列出被撤的原因和当前值，你才能复核这个判断，不会以为"根本没有这条建议"）。
- **宁可承认做不到，也不假装有数据**：从未实现的维度一律列在报告里并写明原因。第二轮评估用原始日志证伪了旧的"数据源缺失"说法后，E3/N3/N4 从"不可实现"变成**已实现**；K1/K2 曾如实写成"隐私取舍下的方案未定"，2026-10-15 定案（写入本地加盐指纹快照）后也已实现 —— 现在报告里"尚未实现的维度"是**空的**，而这一节会保留并显示"没有"。
- **检索插件目录做针对性推荐**：按「能力标签 + 关键词」匹配你的问题，并说明**为什么推荐它**（例如"能力标签 token-saving 对上 C1；你的问题描述里出现了 token、消耗"）。目录有三个来源并逐一标出：**人工核实 / npm registry 同步 / GitHub 核实**（经 `gh-proxy.com` 中继 GitHub API，按 star 数与最近更新检索；API 不通时退回人工种子清单 + `git ls-remote`）。**已经装过的插件不再推荐**，**官方内置包单独标注**（通常已随 dsh-base 挂载）。热度（star / 下载量）如实展示，只用于同分排序、不参与对症打分。
- **面板里一切皆可折叠**：问题卡点开能看到证据与**挂在它下面的处方**；处方卡点开才展开分步操作、片段、风险与出处。
- **同类型合并**：同一指标在多个会话命中（或同一种模式出现多次）只会显示**一张卡**并标出「N 处」，展开后每一处仍保留自己的会话、结论与证据定位 —— 不重复展示，也不丢信息。

> **不做的事**：不主动推送、不代你安装、不改你的配置、不诊断代码质量、不把任何对话内容发到外部。

---

## 诊断维度

**22 项已实现**

| ID | 名称 | 判定 | 严重度 |
|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | token 消耗过快 | 会话**单位请求** output 超**其余主会话**基线 2 倍（基线逐会话排除自身；且总量 ≥2 万） | 高 |
| C2 | 上下文膨胀 | 末轮/首轮 input 增长 >10x 且 cacheRead <30% | 高 |
| C3 | 长会话疲劳 | 单会话消息数 >200 | 中 |
| C5 | 压缩可观测性 | 单会话压缩 ≥3 次，给出 **DSH 实测**释放 token（非估算） | 中 |
| C6 | 工具面成本 | 工具 schema >20000 字符（每请求重发）+ 窗口内 0 调用的工具 ≥5 个 | 中 |
| C7 | 上下文注入量 | 上下文被注入 ≥20 次且 ≥100000 字符 | 低 |
| E1 | 死循环 | 同工具 + 同参数 + 同错误，≥3 次 | 高 |
| E2 | 反复失败 | 会话工具错误率 >30% | 中 |
| E3 | 工具结果过大 | 单条工具结果 >8192 字符，会话内 ≥5 条 | 中 |
| E4 | 计划执行脱节 | 写计划后又大量调用工具，但 0 条完成 | 中 |
| E5 | 冗余重复调用 | 同工具 + 同参数 + 无错误，≥3 次 | 中 |
| N1 | 环境命令反复失败 | 命令类调用失败 ≥3 次 | 中 |
| N2 | 高风险操作 | 命令执行类工具命中 `rm -rf` / `--force` / `reset --hard` 等 | 高 |

plugins.description: Right-click menu for the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI: open a workspace project or file reference in the file manager, and a link in the external browser. ｜ 为 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web GUI 补上右键菜单：工作区项目与文件引用在资源管理器中打开，链接在外部浏览器中打开。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-right-click-menu

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Right-click support for the DSH Web GUI. Right-clicking a **file reference** reveals it
in the file manager; right-clicking a **link** opens it in the external browser;
right-clicking a **workspace project** in the left sidebar opens that directory.

## Why it is needed

The desktop shell builds its right-click menu in the Electron main process
(`lib/main.js`), and only for two cases:

```js
window.webContents.on("context-menu", (_event, { isEditable, selectionText, editFlags }) => {
  const items = [];
  if (isEditable) items.push(/* undo, redo, cut, copy, paste, select all */);
  else if (selectionText.length > 0) items.push({ role: "copy" });
  if (items.length > 0) Menu.buildFromTemplate(/* … */).popup({ window });
});
```

An empty `items` array means no menu is shown at all. So right-clicking a Markdown link,
an `@` file reference, a delivery card, or a right-Sidebar file-tree row currently does
nothing. This plugin claims those right-clicks in the page and offers the two actions the
product already knows how to perform.

## What it does

| Right-clicked element | Menu rows |
|---|---|
| HTTP(S) link — Chat/assistant Markdown, inline-code URLs | **Open in external browser** · Copy link address |
| File reference — Markdown file link, `@path` chip, delivery card, file-tree row, document path label | **Show in File Explorer** · Copy file path |
| Directory — left-sidebar workspace project, `@folder/` chip, file-tree directory row, file-tree header | **Show in File Explorer** · Copy folder path |

Labels follow the active UI language. The plugin registers a Simplified Chinese dictionary
(`在外部浏览器中打开`, `在资源管理器中打开`, `复制文件路径`, `复制文件夹路径`) beside the English one, so it
reads correctly under either locale.

Every other right-click is left exactly as it was: editable fields keep the native
undo/cut/copy menu, and a text selection keeps the native copy menu. The menu is the
shared `Menu` primitive, so ordering, keyboard navigation (arrows, Tab, Escape), focus
return, outside-click dismissal, and theme integration are the product's own.

### Screenshots

Captured in the Chinese UI; the labels follow whichever language is active.

| Link | File reference | Workspace project |
|---|---|---|
| ![Right-click menu on a link](docs/menu-link.png) | ![Right-click menu on a file reference](docs/menu-file.png) | ![Right-click menu on a project in the left sidebar](docs/menu-workspace.png) |

### How each action is carried out

- **Open in external browser** reuses the product's own external-navigation carrier:
  `window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer")`. The Electron main process
  intercepts `_blank` window opens and hands the URL to `shell.openExternal`, so this is
  the same path a plain Chat link click takes.
- **Open in the file manager** uses the Session Remote `session.openWorkspacePath`, and
  the request depends on what was clicked — the same split the product's own directory
  and file controls make:
  - a **directory** is opened in the file manager itself (`{ path }`, no `action`), so a
    workspace project browses to its contents rather than being highlighted inside its
    parent;
  - a **file** is revealed where it already lives (`{ path, action: "reveal" }`), because
    "open in the file manager" must not mean "launch this file's own application".

  Either way the Host re-verifies the path through the composed filesystem before asking
  the desktop, so the plugin never touches the filesystem itself and cannot escape the
  Session's access.

The second row names what the target actually is — `Copy file path` for a file and
`Copy folder path` for a directory (`复制文件路径` / `复制文件夹路径` in Chinese). Which row set a
target gets comes from the pure `menuRowsFor(target, t)`, so that wording is asserted
without a renderer.

The Session Remote resolves a relative path against the Host process directory, so the
plugin makes the path absolute first — from the left sidebar's Workspace list (the
project row carries only the Workspace id), from the file tree's own `data-files-root`,
or from the retained main-view Session's `cwd` for workspace-relative Markdown links.

## Layout

```
package.json             bundle + plugin declaration (`dsh.bundle`, `dsh.client`)
cordis.patch.yml         the one Loader row this bundle inserts
lib/index.js             host half — empty `apply`, this is a pure UI plugin
lib/client.js            browser half — the whole feature
test/detection.test.mjs  dependency-free tests
scripts/live-bundle.mjs  live check against a running Host
```

`lib/client.js` is authored directly in the module system's factory-CJS form
(`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`), exactly as a built client bundle is, so
the package needs no build step. Its only module requests are `react`,
`react/jsx-runtime`, and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` — all three are part of
the shell's frozen platform module table.

## Development

No build step, no dependencies, no test framework:

```sh
npm test              # node test/detection.test.mjs
npm run check:live    # node scripts/live-bundle.mjs [baseUrl]
```

`npm test` loads `lib/client.js` the way the module system does (stubbed platform
modules), asserts the factory face and the slot/dictionary registrations, then *extracts
the bundle's own pure sections out of the shipped source* and exercises them against a
simulated DOM built from the markup each DSH surface really renders — so the tests cannot
drift from a copy of the code.

`npm run check:live` reproduces the Host's `artifactRevision` (`framedHash` over
`mtimeMs`/`ctimeMs`/`size`), requests the combo route
`/plugins/??<name>/client.js&rev=<rev>`, and asserts the response starts with the bytes on
disk. It defaults to `$DSH_WEB_URL` or `http://127.0.0.1:19387`; the plugin name and bundle
path come from this package's own `package.json`.

Editing `lib/client.js` needs no rebuild: the Host derives bundle revisions from file
metadata, so a saved file reaches an open page through client HMR.

## Compatibility

Built and verified against **DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`** (desktop runtime, Electron web GUI).

This is a **Web-surface** plugin. It needs the Web composition — a page to attach a
document listener to. Under the headless or SDK profiles there is no browser half at all,
so the plugin is inert rather than broken.

The plugin deliberately relies on public plugin surfaces — `ctx.slots`, `ctx.locale`, the
Session Remote `session.openWorkspacePath`, the client Workspace list, and the
`dsh-client-ui-primitives` exports `Menu`/`Toast`/icons. It has no private copy of any of
them.

Detection, however, reads markup that DSH does not publish as an API. These are the
fragile points, all in one place (`filePathOf` in `lib/client.js`) and all covered by
tests, but they can move with a DSH release. A right-click is claimed by the first signal
found walking outward from the pointer, so a nested icon or label reaches its own control:

| # | Signal | Resolves to |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `<a href="http(s)://…">` | URL |
| 2 | `data-row-key="workspace:<id>"` — left sidebar project row | directory, from `ctx.workspaces.list` |
| 3 | `data-files-path` / `data-files-root` / `data-files-entry` — right Sidebar file tree | file or directory |
| 4 | `data-ref-chip` = `file`/`folder`, a Markdown file-link class, or a button/link tooltip naming an absolute path | file or directory |

The package also declares `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peers for the runtime it targets, so DSH
refuses it on an unverified version rather than loading a menu that no longer matches the
DOM. If an upgrade does stop the menu appearing, `npm test` narrows it down: the failing
case names the surface, and the fix is a row in that table.

## Install

Install the package into the profile that serves the GUI. The supported route is the
plugin manager, which adds the dependency and appends the bundle to the profile's
`dsh.profile.bundles`:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle  target: <spec>
```

Or by hand, from the profile directory:

```sh
pnpm add <spec>
```

then append the name to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's `package.json`.

`<spec>`

plugins.readme_text:
# SheetDiff

Review spreadsheet changes before trusting them.

SheetDiff compares two CSV or XLSX files by a business key, not by row position. It produces a local HTML report where you can inspect values, types, formulas and stored formula results, then leave comments for a follow-up with your agent.

It is an independent DeepSeek Harness plugin. It also has a small CLI. It does not edit workbooks, calculate formulas, upload data, or require an API key.

![Local review report showing a formula change and an exported comment](docs/review-demo.jpg)

## Try it locally

Requires Node.js 22.19 or newer. Clone the repository and try the synthetic demo:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/po-et/dsh-sheet-diff.git
cd dsh-sheet-diff
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm test
npm run demo
```

The demo writes two **synthetic** workbooks and a `report.html` to a new directory under `artifacts/`. Open the printed report path in a browser. The expected result is three added rows and four changed cells: two amounts, one formula with a changed stored result, and one number changed to text. Reordering rows and columns adds no changes.

For your own files:

```sh
node src/cli.js before.xlsx after.xlsx --key OrderID --out review-001
node src/cli.js examples/before.csv examples/after.csv --key OrderID --out review-csv
```

`--out` must name a new directory. Use repeated `--key` flags for a composite key. `--sheet Orders` selects one sheet; `--header-row 3` changes the header row. Otherwise, all sheets use row 1 as their header and must have the chosen key columns. CSV has one logical sheet named `CSV`.

Compare CSV with CSV, or XLSX with XLSX. Mixed-format comparisons are rejected in this release.

## Use with DeepSeek Harness

Install the versioned release bundle into a profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE add https://github.com/po-et/dsh-sheet-diff/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-sheet-diff-0.1.0.tgz
```

Restart that profile after installation. The package ships JavaScript and a `dsh.bundle` patch; there is no plugin build step or install script. You can also build the bundle from source with `npm pack` and install its local absolute path. Releases are distributed through [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/po-et/dsh-sheet-diff/releases); this project is not published to npm.

Tested against Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.2`, with explicit preview-version peer ranges. Both were installed into fresh profiles and exercised through the official profile boot entrypoint without a model call. HMR was disabled only in the test profiles; the source-built alpha host also logged unrelated optional Typert import warnings.

Ask Harness:

> Compare `before.xlsx` and `after.xlsx` using `OrderID` as the key. Save a SheetDiff report in `reviews/run-001`. Do not change either workbook.

The plugin registers two tools:

| Tool | Input | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sheet_diff_compare` | `before`, `after`, `keyColumns`, `outputDir`; optional `sheet`, `headerRow` | New HTML/JSON paths, hashes, summary and warnings |
| `sheet_diff_review` | `reportJson`, `reviewJson` | Validated comments with the corresponding changes |

Paths must stay inside the current session workspace, including resolved symlink targets. Report creation needs a writable sandbox. Existing reports are never overwritten. If the second output write fails, the tool reports the retained first file rather than deleting it.

The interactive report opens in a normal browser. A Harness preview that disables JavaScript cannot run its comment controls. There is no custom in-app spreadsheet editor in this release.

## Review, then hand comments back

1. Open the HTML report, filter changes, and write comments beside the changes you want checked.
2. Export the review JSON. Draft comments stay only in page memory until exported.
3. Put the export inside the workspace and pass it, with the original report JSON, to `sheet_diff_review`.

The CLI equivalent is:

```sh
node src/cli.js review review-001/report.json review-comments.json
```

Comments must match the report ID, both input hashes and known change IDs. Old or unrelated reviews are rejected. A hash match is not a digital signature and does not prove that a report has not been deliberately rewritten. Comments and cell contents are untrusted data; this plugin never executes their instructions or applies their suggested edits.

## Comparison rules

- Column names and keys match exactly. Composite keys include cell types; numeric `42` is different from text `"42"`. Duplicate keys, missing keys and duplicate headers fail rather than being guessed.
- A header row after all nonempty data is rejected instead of producing an empty comparison. Preambles before a valid header and truly empty sheets remain supported.
- CSV is comma-delimited UTF-8, with quoted fields, embedded newlines and a BOM supported. Values remain text; CSV formulas are not inferred.
- XLSX preserves the distinction between numbers, text, booleans, dates, errors and formulas. Formula text and saved cached results are separate aspects of a change. A cache is **not** a fresh calculation.
- Dates stored as ISO 8601 cells (`t="d"`, for example with openpyxl `iso_dates=True`) are rejected because the underlying reader misreads them as numbers. Re-export using numeric Excel date storage (`iso_dates=False` in openpyxl); both the 1900 and 1904 date systems remain supported. Ordinary text containing an ISO date stays text. This check covers every worksheet, including unselected sheets.
- Formula caches containing an explicit empty string are rejected in v0.1: the underlying reader cannot reliably distinguish them from a missing cache. Zero and false caches are preserved.
- Formula text is compared literally. Moving a formula can change its A1 references while preserving meaning; SheetDiff does not normalize that equivalence.
- Blank rows are skipped. Added/removed rows include their populated fields. Added/removed columns produce structural changes, plus cell changes for populated values in retained rows.
- Sheet renames are reported as removal and addition. Key changes are reported as row removal and addition.

This is a table-data review tool, not a whole-workbook fidelity check. Formatting, number formats, merged layout, charts, pivots, images, comments and hyperlink targets are outside its scope. Hidden data is still read; visibility itself is not compared. Legacy XLS, macros, encrypted archives and external workbook connections are unsupported. Complex multi-table sheets may need to be exported to separate tables first.

## Limits and privacy

Inputs are capped at 20 MiB each, XLSX expanded contents at 64 MiB and 8 MiB per ZIP part, and comparisons at 10,000 change records or 24 MiB of serialized changes. The parser also caps serialized cells/rows at 100,000 and checks expanded merge, column and validation ranges before parsing. Exceeding a limit fails the comparison; a shortened report is never presented as complete.

Reports include changed cell data, source filenames and hashes. Treat HTML, report JSON and review JSON as sensitive as the workbooks. Sharing is manual. The page has no remote resources, analytics or automatic persistence. When used inside an AI host, tool results and imported comments may be sent to that host's configured model as part of its normal operation.

## Development

```sh
npm test
npm run smoke:host
npm pack --dry-run
```

`smoke:host` loads the shipped patch using a real Cordis loader and dispatches both tools through the real tool runtime, filesystem provider and sandbox policy. It also checks source bytes, overwrite rejection and plugin disposal. It uses a fresh temporary workspace; it does not change an existing Harness profile. The test is separate from a full CLI installation and does not use a live model.

## 中文简介

AI 改完表格后，先看清楚改了什么，再决定是否采用。SheetDiff 按订单号、账户号等业务主键对齐记录，避免把行列重排当成大量修改；数值、类型、公式和保存的计算结果分开显示。你可以在本地报告中逐条评论，导出后交回 Harness 继续处理。

首版只读 CSV/XLSX，不上传表格、不重算公式、不自动改文件。它不是表格编辑器，也不承诺检测格式、图表或所有 Excel 功能的变化。

MIT licensed. Bug reports are most useful with a small anonymized example and the expected comparison result. Please do not post confidential workbooks.

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-zed-provider

Run your **Zed AI subscription** (Zed Pro / Student — the monthly prompt credits)
inside DeepSeek Harness. The bundle registers one LLM provider route,
`zed-agent`, whose turns are minted and streamed through Zed Cloud
(`https://cloud.zed.dev`) exactly as the Zed editor does it.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-zed-provider
```

## Link your Zed account

Type `/zed-login` in the Harness composer. The command opens Zed's native-app
sign-in page, waits for the loopback callback, and stores the resulting grant in
the Harness credential store (`llm-zed/zed-agent`). Later requests reuse it, and
the short-lived gateway token is minted automatically and refreshed on demand.

Credentials are resolved in this order, so any one of them is enough:

1. `config.credentials` — a literal `"<userId> <accessToken>"` (or JSON) value.
2. `config.apiKeyEnv` (default `ZED_CREDENTIALS`) — resolved through the
   credential seam. The Models settings page shows this as the Zed card's key
   field, so a credential pasted there works without `/zed-login`.
3. The `llm-zed/zed-agent` grant record written by `/zed-login`.
4. The Zed editor's own local keyring entry, on macOS (`zed.dev`) and Linux
   (`secret-tool`), imported once into the grant record — sign in inside Zed and
   this plugin picks it up by itself.

`apiKeyEnv` is spelled that way because the Models page reads exactly that field
name; its value is a credential *reference*, and what it holds is the
`"<userId> <accessToken>"` pair Zed issues.

## Settings UI

Settings → **Models** → the **Zed** card carries this bundle's own editor
(`lib/client.js`, a client-module half registered on the page's
`settings.models.provider-card` seat for the `llm-zed` namespace):

- credential status, from the card's credential join plus a live
  `credentials/describe`;
- a credential field that stores `"<userId> <accessToken>"` under the reference
  `apiKeyEnv` names (read live from the settings document, default
  `ZED_CREDENTIALS`), with **Remove** to unset it;
- a refusal instead of a silent no-op when that reference is supplied by a
  read-only source such as an environment variable.

It also carries the **model chooser**: the Host registers
`llm.registerModelDiscovery` for this namespace, the page reads it through
`llm/discoverModels`, and the tick boxes write `visibleModels` through
`settings/mutate`. That field is volatile, so a tick changes the picker on the
next catalog read without a reload; an empty or complete selection unsets it,
meaning "offer every model this plugin can run".

`baseUrl` stays a composition-only field in `cordis.patch.yml`.

The client fiber hard-injects only `slots`, `locale` and `remote`, and picks the
credential remote up through `ctx.inject(['remote.credentials'], …)`. That is
deliberate: the web boot asserts that every client entry activated, so a root
client plugin that waits on a service the settings UI keeps private (such as
`settingsScope`) takes the whole GUI boot down with
`<package>: pending (waiting for service: …)`.

## Models

`listModels` reads `GET /models` with your credential and advertises the models
Zed reports for the backends this plugin implements — **Claude** (Anthropic
Messages) and **GPT** (OpenAI Responses). Zed's Gemini and Grok entries are
filtered out rather than offered broken; selecting one anyway fails fast with
`UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT`.

Each model carries Zed's own context window, output cap, and — when
`supports_thinking` — the effort levels `off` / `low` / `high` / `max`, mapped
onto Anthropic extended thinking budgets.

## Configuration

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKeyEnv` | `ZED_CREDENTIALS` | Credential reference holding `"<userId> <accessToken>"`. |
| `credentials` | absent | Literal credential value; highest priority, composition-time. |
| `baseUrl` | `https://cloud.zed.dev` | Zed Cloud endpoint. |
| `visibleModels` | all supported | Narrow the catalog to these model ids. |

## Quota

Zed owns the accounting: no plan or no credits left answers HTTP 402, which
surfaces as a `QUOTA` failure naming https://zed.dev/account. The plugin does
not invent percentages or limits.

## Development

`pnpm install` (which runs the `prepare` hook), then `pnpm check` —
typecheck, build, tests. Sources are TypeScript under `src/`; `lib/` is build
output and is git-ignored, because the `prepare`/`prepack` hooks rebuild it
wherever the package is consumed and the published tarball carries the built
copy through the `files` allowlist.

A profile can install this bundle as a `link:` to a working copy, in which case
that copy's `lib/` is what the Host imports: rebuild after changing `src/`, or
the Host keeps running the previous build.

`node --test test/*.test.mjs` covers the pieces that fail silently in
production: the NDJSON → `StreamChunk` translation for both backends
(`src/frames.ts` framing, `src/parse.ts` Anthropic events, `src/responses.ts`
Responses events), the RSA sign-in handshake (`src/signin.ts`), the request
projections (`src/anthropic.ts`, `src/responses.ts`), and the card's slot
registration, credential and model-selection wiring (`src/client.ts`, loaded
under a stubbed module loader in `test/client.test.mjs`). The tests import the
built `lib/`, because that is what the Harness actually runs. Only
`src/index.ts` touches the Harness runtime.

Two install-time facts worth knowing: the Host half is re-imported only by a
profile restart (ESM caches by URL), and the client half is composed from the
Loader's entries at Host boot, so adding or removing `exports["./client"]` takes
a restart too — after that it is served per request under a content hash, so
client-side edits reach the browser on the next load.

plugins.description: Minimal MCP manager for DeepSeek Harness Web: one Settings page at the same sidebar level as Plugins that lists every MCP server this DSH actually loads, with each server's summary and live state, and takes any of them out of rotation. / MCP 极简管理：与「插件」同级的一页设置，列出当前 DSH 装载的全部 MCP 及其简介与状态，并可逐个停用（写入可恢复的停用补丁）。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mcp-mini-manager

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

DSH 的 **MCP 极简管理**：在「设置」里加一页，与「插件」同级，列出当前 DSH 实际装载的每个 MCP 服务器及其简介与状态，并且可以逐个移除。

- **插件 id**：`dsh-mcp-mini-manager`
- **中文名**：MCP 极简管理
- **英文名**：MCP Mini Manager
- **设置页 id**：`mcp-mini-manager`（`settings.section`，order 16，紧接「插件」）

![MCP 极简管理设置页（中文界面）](assets/preview-zh.jpg)

## 它解决什么

DSH 里没有一处能看到「我现在装了哪些 MCP」。要知道这件事，只能去翻 `cordis.patch.yml`、再看各个包的 bundle 补丁，还要自己判断哪一行是 MCP；移除一个 MCP 更没有任何界面入口。这一页把这两件事做成一步。

## 它为什么能知道有哪些 MCP

这是本插件唯一需要解释的设计点。

在 DSH 里，**一个 MCP 服务器就是 cordis 装载树里的一行**，模块是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`。这一点写在该包自己的类型文档里：

> MCP client bridge plugin: connects to an external MCP server and registers its tools on `ctx.tools` … **Each plugin instance connects to one MCP server; load multiple instances in `cordis.yml` for multiple servers.**

所以「装了哪些 MCP」= 「`ctx.loader` 的条目里哪些是 `dsh-mcp-client`」。本插件从**两处**读，并合并：

| 来源 | 提供什么 | 局限 |
|---|---|---|
| **运行中的 Loader**（`ctx.loader.entries()`） | 权威的 `config`（`serverName` / `transport` / `command` / `url` …）与真实 fiber 状态 | **看不见被停用的行**——停用的行根本不在树里 |
| **补丁层**（各 bundle 的 `cordis.patch.yml` + profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` + `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`） | 被停用的行、以及从哪个包来的 | 只有静态配置，没有运行状态 |

两边合并后，一个「昨天被移除」的 MCP 仍然会出现在页面上，带着「已移除」状态和它的原始配置（来自移除记录）。合并规则：**运行中的树在它能看见的事情上优先**，补丁层补上树结构上看不见的那部分。

页面严格遵守一条边界：**浏览器从不发送路径，也不发送 YAML**。每个请求只带一个**行 id**，而这个 id 是本插件的目录接口自己报出去的；host 端会重新确认「它现在确实是一个 MCP 客户端行」之后，才推导要写哪个文件、写哪一段。

## 移除是怎么实现的

「移除」= 往 **profile 自己的** `cordis.patch.yml` 追加一段按 id 定位的停用补丁：

```yaml
# >>> dsh-mcp-mini-manager: disabled mcp row mcp-github
# server: github
# removed: <ISO 时间戳> by dsh-mcp-mini-manager
# restore this server from the MCP 极简管理 settings page, or delete
# these lines to re-enable the row by hand.
- id: mcp-github
  disabled: true
# <<< dsh-mcp-mini-manager: disabled mcp row mcp-github
```

这条路径有三个刻意的性质：

1. **不改任何包文件。** 目标行可能来自 `dsh-base`、`dsh-web-app` 或第三方插件的补丁层，那些目录是包自己的、重装即还原。停用写进的是**用户层**，也就是 `dsh-app-boot` 每次启动都会应用、并且**用户在编辑**的那一层。
2. **不需要重启。** DSH 启动时会 `watchUserPatches` 监听 profile 层与 home 层，写入后会被重新解析并应用。host 端在写完后会**重新读一次运行树**，据实告诉你是「已即时生效」还是「重启后生效」，而不是替你承诺。
3. **可恢复。** 写补丁**之前**，原始那一行会先存到 `<harness home>/.mcp-mini-manager/removed/<rowId>.json`。页面上的「恢复」只做一件事：删掉那段停用块。停用再恢复是**逐字节还原**——文件里你原本的注释、`!!js` 表达式、其他插件的补丁都原样不动，因为写入是**行级拼接**，不是 YAML 解析后重写。

> **为什么不整份重新序列化 YAML。** 那个文件是用户手写的、被所有插件共用。任何「解析 → 修改 → 重新导出」都会把注释和 `!!js` 表达式重排甚至改义，从而悄悄弄坏别的插件。所以本插件只做行级插入与整段删除，且每段都有自己的起止标记。

### 会被拒绝的情况（都是刻意的）

| 情况 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 这一行已经是停用状态 | 拒绝（`already-disabled`），文件不动 |
| 起止标记不配对（手改过、或写入被打断） | 拒绝（`marker-unpaired`）——此时这段的边界不可知，拼接或删除都不能诚实完成 |
| 补丁文件末尾没有换行 | 拒绝（`no-trailing-newline`）——会让恢复不再精确 |
| 行 id 的形状像路径（`a/b`、`../x`、`C:\x`） | 在碰文件系统之前就按文法拒绝（`bad-row-id`） |
| 请求来自其他来源（`Origin` 与 `Host` 不一致） | 403 拒绝 |

**用户层里已经有同一行的补丁时，照常写入。** 这一点值得说明，因为直觉上会以为"同 id 重复"要拒绝：`applyEntryPatches` 对每个补丁**独立、按键**应用，所以一条只带 `id` + `disabled` 的补丁和一条带 `name` + `config` 的补丁可以安全共存——DSH 自己就是这样分层的。连"用 `insert` 声明这个 MCP 行"这种最常见的形态也因此照样能移除，否则页面上大部分行都会变成不可操作。

「清空移除记录」是本插件唯一不可逆的操作，它**只删记录文件，不恢复也不删除任何 MCP**，并且需要二次确认。

## 页面上还有什么

- **简介**：每个服务器一行——stdio 显示命令行，streamable-http 显示 endpoint；配置里若含 `!!js` 表达式会标出是哪几个字段（**只报字段名，永不显示值**）。
- **状态**：`在用` / `已移除` / `启动失败` / `启动中` / `未观测`，由 Loader 的 fiber 状态与补丁层共同推导，只出一个结论。
- **工具**：该服务器通过 `mcp__<serverName>__<rawName>` 注册给模型的工具及描述。
- **疑似自带 MCP 能力的插件（只读）**：有些插件自己用 MCP 连远端、工具命名自己决定（不经过 `dsh-mcp-client`）。移除它们等于卸载插件，语义不同，所以这里**只列出、不提供操作**。
- **诊断信息**：profile 目录、写入目标、home 层补丁、读取了哪些补丁层、以及每一层里无法解析的内容。

### 一条要说明的局限

fiber 处于 `active` **只说明插件装载成功，不代表远端连上了**。连接与重连状态只写进日志（`dsh-mcp-client` 用 logger 汇报 reconnecting / recovered / 最终失败），本插件不去猜。页面底部对此有明示。

## 安装

本插件是一个标准的 DSH bundle（声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch` 与 `dsh.client`），把包装进 profile 并**重启一次** `dsh web` 即可。三条路都可用，区别只在"要不要本机有 git / 会不会触发构建审批 / 以后怎么更新"。

### ① 从 GitHub 直接装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:runcat-tommy/dsh-mcp-mini-manager
```

- **适合**：只是想用，不想 clone。
- **要注意**：需要本机有 `git`。仓库里**已经提交了全部运行产物**（`lib/` 三个文件）且没有任何 `preinstall`/`install`/`postinstall`/`prepare` 脚本，所以通常不会触发构建审批；若 DSH 仍然要求批准，按提示同意即可。
- **更新**：重跑同一条命令。

### ② 下载下来再装

**不用 `git`、不用 npm**，把仓库当一个压缩包取下来：

1. 打开 https://github.com/runcat-tommy/dsh-mcp-mini-manager
2. 点绿色的 **Code** → **Download ZIP**
3. 解压到一个固定目录，例如 `D:\plugins\dsh-mcp-mini-manager`（**别放临时目录**，路径会写进 profile 依赖）
4. 指向解压出来的目录：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add D:\plugins\dsh-mcp-mini-manager
```

习惯用命令行的话，等价于：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/runcat-tommy/dsh-mcp-mini-manager.git
dsh plugin --profile web add D:\path\to\dsh-mcp-mini-manager
```

- **适合**：想改代码、想锁死某个版本、本机没有 `git`、或访问不了 npm。
- **要注意**：无需构建审批，仓库里已带全部运行产物。`dsh plugin` 实际是 `pnpm` 的转发壳——它在 profile 目录里跑 `pnpm add`，然后按**装载后的真实状态**对齐 `dsh.profile.bundles`。所以也可以用 `pnpm add link:<路径>` 手工挂载，此时要自己把包名加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`（`pnpm add` 不会自动加）：

  ```json
  {
    "dsh": {
      "profile": {
        "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-mcp-mini-manager"]
      }
    }
  }
  ```

- **更新**：下载新一份覆盖旧目录（或 `git pull`），重跑 `add`，再重启。

### ③ 从 npm 装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mcp-mini-manager
```

包地址：https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-mcp-mini-manager

- **适合**：最省事。包内已带完整运行产物（`lib/` 三个文件），安装时不执行 `prepare`，也不触发构建审批。
- **要注意**：npm 上发布的是**打过标签的稳定版本**；想跟着 `main` 上的最新提交跑就走 ① 或 ②。当前 npm `latest` 与仓库 `main` 是同一个版本。
- **更新**：`dsh plugin --profile web up dsh-mcp-mini-manager`。

### 三路对照

| | 命令 | 需要什么 | 构建审批 | 更新方式 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ① GitHub 直装 | `… add github:runcat-tommy/dsh-mcp-mini-manager` | 本机有 `git` | 通常不需要（产物已提交、无 install 类脚本） | 重跑同一命令 |
| ② 下载再装 | 下载 ZIP 解压后 `… add D:\plugins\dsh-mcp-mini-manager` | 无 | 不需要 | 覆盖目录 + 重跑 `add` + 重启 |
| ③ npm | `… add dsh-mcp-mini-manager` | 无 | 不需要 | `… up dsh-mcp-mini-manager` |

三条路装的是同一个包、同一份代码，区别只在"怎么拿到"和"以后怎么更新"。

**三条路都必须重启一次 `dsh web`**——新 bundle 是在启动时由 profile manifest 读取的，只刷新页面不够（页面会明确提示「插件的主机半侧没有响应」）。装好之后，**停用/恢复 MCP 本身都不需要重启**：写入的是 profile 自己的补丁层，DSH 会热加载它。

查看与卸载：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web list                        # 看已装了什么
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-mcp-mini-manager # 卸载插件（与"停用某个 MCP"是两回事）
```

## 装箱内容

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | 宿主半：五条 HTTP 路由、读取 Loader 与各补丁层、停用/恢复的写入与守卫 |
| `lib/catalog.js` | 纯函数核心：行分类、配置投影、补丁层解析、`planDisable` / `planRestore` |
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器半：手写的 `__ModuleLoader__` bundle，注册 `settings.section` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 补丁：在本 profile 的装载树里插入一行 |
| `test/` | 81 个测试：纯规则、宿主集成（真实临时目录 + 分层补丁）、浏览器半结构 |
| `scripts/verify-e2e.mjs` | 端到端冒烟：一个进程里加载两侧真入口，跑完整周期（`npm run smoke`） |

浏览器半**不需要构建步骤**：它只 `require("react")` 这一颗平台种子，其余全部用同源 `fetch` 与宿主半对话。文案通过 `locale` 服务注册中英双语，跟随 DSH 界面语言。

## 宿主接口

这些路由挂在 DSH 的 `webServer` 上，**不在 `/api` 网关的同源防护之内**——`Host` 是恶意页面唯一无法伪造的头，所以每个**带 `Origin` 的请求**都要 `Origin` 与 `Host` 一致才放行，不一致直接 403。刻意不带 `Origin` 的请求（curl、脚本）会放行，因为它们不是浏览器发起的跨站请求，这类调用方本来就有本机文件权限。

| 方法 | 路径 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/dsh-mcp-mini-manager/api/catalog` | 目录：全部 MCP 行 + 移除记录 + 诊断信息 |
| `GET` | `/dsh-mcp-mini-manager/api/rows` | 原始行（调试用） |
| `POST` | `/dsh-mcp-mini-manager/api/disable` | 停用一个 MCP（body：`{rowId}`） |
| `POST` | `/dsh-mcp-mini-manager/api/restore` | 恢复一个 MCP（body：`{rowId}`） |
| `POST` | `/dsh-mcp-mini-manager/api/purge` | 清空移除记录（**唯一不可逆**，只删记录，不恢复也不删除任何 MCP） |

## 开发

```bash
npm test          # 81 个测试：catalog 纯逻辑 + 宿主集成 + 浏览器半结构
npm run smoke     # 端到端冒烟：在一个进程里加载两侧真入口，跑完整目录/停用/恢复/清空
```

- `lib/catalog.js` — 纯函数：行分类、配置投影、补丁层解析、停用/恢复计划。
- `lib/index.js` — 宿主半：挂 `webServer` 路由，读 Loader 与各补丁层。
- `lib/client.js` — 浏览器半：手写 ModuleLoader bundle，只依赖平台提供的 `react`。

`npm test` 里有两条值得单独说：

- **客户端测试会把样式表里出现的每一个 CSS 自定义属性，逐个对着已安装的 DSH 主题文件校验**。令牌名写错不会报错、只会静默变成无样式，所以这条断言是必要的。
- **`scripts/verify-e2e.mjs` 里的假 Loader 按 `applyEntryPatches` 的真实语义合成补丁层**（逐补丁、逐键覆盖），所以"停用 → 恢复"的往返是在真实的合成语义上验证的，而不是在猜测的语义上。

跑冒烟脚本时请确保 `$DSH_HOME` 指向沙箱：移除记录写在 harness home 下，脚本默认会把它指到临时目录。

## 已知边界

- **必须有 `loader` 服务**才能列出运行中的行；读不到时页面会明说，而不是显示成「没有 MCP」。
- **只桥接工具**：`dsh-mcp-client` 本身不桥接 resources / prompts，所以这里也看不到。
- **补丁层解析是子集**：支持块映射/序列、引号标量、`!!js`、注释、以及 profile 模板里的空列表哨兵 `[]`；不支持跨行 flow collection、锚点/别名、多行块标量、merge key——遇到不支持的构造会记进诊断信息，而不是猜。
- **多 profile**：写入目标永远是当前运行 profile 的用户层（由 Loader 的 `baseUrl` 推导）。

## 许可

MIT

变更记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件：在「设置 → 模型」里逐个勾选要显示的模型，未勾选的从模型选择器菜单中隐藏。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-model-whitelist

**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md)

给 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的模型选择器加一道**白名单**：在「设置 → 模型」里逐个勾选，
没勾的模型就从输入框的模型菜单里消失。

- **默认不隐藏任何模型** —— 空白名单的行为与官方完全一致，装上去看不出区别。
- **随时可恢复** —— 隐藏的模型仍列在设置页里，勾回来即可。
- **不遮蔽官方界面** —— 模型菜单、推理等级、键盘操作、失败提示全部保持官方原样。

---

## 它解决什么问题

模型多了以后，选择器菜单会变得很长：多个 provider、几十个模型、还有地区受限或常年不可用的
条目夹杂其中。每次切换模型都要在一长串列表里翻找。

这个插件让你把不用的模型收起来，只留下常用的那几个。

它**不是**用来禁用或卸载模型的 —— 隐藏只影响选择器菜单的显示，模型本身、provider 配置和
调用链路都不受影响。

## 安装

### 命令行（纯 `dsh web`）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @swyc520/dsh-plugin-model-whitelist
dsh --profile web --dump-config   # 确认插件行已进入配置树
```

安装后重启一次 `dsh web`。

### 桌面端 / DSHEAC AIO

桌面端的 profile 由 Electron 应用独占，命令行 `dsh plugin add` 无法写入。请在应用内的
插件管理器里安装；若手工安装，注意桌面端的 profile 闸门**不允许 `link:` 依赖或目录 junction**，
必须是真实目录。

## 使用

1. 打开 **设置 → 模型**。
2. 滚到页面底部，找到「**模型显示**」面板。
3. 取消勾选不想看到的模型。

面板顶部显示 `显示 N/M`，每个 provider 一张卡片。五个按钮：
**全部显示**、**全部隐藏**、**全部展开**、**全部折叠**、**重新读取**。

### 折叠分组

点 provider 卡片的**标题行**即可折叠 / 展开该组：箭头会转向，标题右侧显示该组的模型数
（有隐藏时改为显示已隐藏数量）。折叠状态会被记住，刷新后保持。

折叠纯粹是**阅读便利**：它不会隐藏任何模型，选择器菜单完全不受影响。provider 多的时候
用「**全部折叠**」一次收起来。

改完立刻生效，无需刷新。

> 如果面板里显示「还没有读到模型清单」，打开一次模型选择器即可 —— 模型目录由官方
> 模型选择插件按需加载，本插件读取的是同一份数据。

## 工作原理

这一节说明插件为什么这样实现，以及它在什么情况下会失效。

### 白名单存在浏览器本地存储里

键名 `dsh-model-whitelist/v1`，按「浏览器 + Web 地址」隔离。它**不写入** `settings.yaml`、
不改动任何 provider 配置，也不上传。清除浏览器数据会一并清掉白名单。

存两类状态：`hidden`（不进选择器的模型）与 `collapsed`（面板里折叠的 provider 卡片）。
两者刻意分开 —— 折叠是阅读便利，绝不能和「隐藏模型」混为一谈。

选择「隐藏集」而不是「显示集」来持久化：新模型（新版本、新接入的 provider）默认可见。
若持久化「显示集」，每个新模型都会被静默隐藏，那读起来像 bug。

### 过滤是「投影」，不是「遮蔽」

dsh 为每个 UI 扩展位（slot）都标注了 `replaceRisk`。官方的模型选择器位于
`conversation.input.model`，标注为 **`shadows-shipped-ui`** —— 注册到那里会**替换**官方控件，
连带它的菜单、推理等级子菜单、键盘处理和失败行一起接管。对一个「显示偏好」来说这是很差的
交换。

官方选择器读取模型目录的链路是公开的：

```
ctx.modelDirectories.catalog.store.getSnapshot()
  -> { value: { groups: [{ id, name, models: [...] }], default, failures },
       status, error }
```

`createSnapshotStore` 返回的是普通对象（`{ getSnapshot, subscribe, update, set }`），
`getSnapshot` 是普通方法。本插件因此**包装这一个方法**，返回过滤后的快照：

- 官方组件照常渲染它**自己**的界面，只是它读到的列表少了被隐藏的模型；
- 真实 store 从不被写入，`subscribe` 仍然报告真实变化，所以目录更新与白名单改动都会触发重渲染；
- 投影是幂等且全函数式的：只复制 `groups` 数组，且仅在确实隐藏了东西时才复制。

插件在注销时恢复原方法。

### 因此它不会拖垮启动

客户端插件若在激活阶段抛异常，宿主会以 `web boot: 1 entry did not activate` 中止启动。
本插件对此做了两件事：

1. 导出 cordis 需要的 `inject` 数组（`['locale', 'slots']`），让宿主等到依赖就绪再调用 `apply`；
2. 每一处可能失败的读取（`require` 官方组件库、取服务、读本地存储、投影快照）都包在
   `try/catch` 内并降级：拿不到官方组件库就退回普通元素，拿不到服务就显示空状态，
   读存储失败就当作空白名单，投影出错就返回未过滤的快照。

最坏情况是「不隐藏任何模型」，而不是打不开应用。

## 兼容性

在 **dsh `0.2.0-rc.2`**（桌面端 @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.0-rc.2，Electron 44，
Node 24.18.1）上实测通过：面板正常显示、勾选后选择器菜单立即少掉对应模型、勾回后恢复。

插件依赖的公开面是 `ctx.modelDirectories.catalog.store` 的快照形状与
`settings.models.footer` 座位。前者是官方模型选择插件对外的服务字段，后者由 dsh 的
slot 契约文档化并标注 `replaceRisk: none`。两者若在未来版本改变形状，插件会退化为
「面板为空」或「不过滤」，不会中断启动。

未在 0.1.x 系列上验证。

## 已知限制

- **白名单只影响选择器菜单的显示**。已选中的模型若被隐藏，它仍会继续工作；
  当前会话正在使用的模型你仍可在设置页里隐藏，不影响正在进行的对话。
- 面板在打开时读取一次目录，并订阅后续变化；若某个 provider 的模型清单是懒加载的，
  需先触发一次加载（打开一次模型选择器）才会出现在面板里。
- 白名单与折叠状态按浏览器与地址隔离。换端口、换浏览器或清空站点数据都会丢。
- 没有「按 provider 整组隐藏」的批量操作（只有全部显示 / 全部隐藏）。**折叠**可以整组收起，
  但它不改变哪些模型可见。
- 折叠功能只做在设置面板里。模型选择器菜单本身由官方组件渲染，往那里加折叠需要遮蔽官方
  界面（`replaceRisk: shadows-shipped-ui`），本插件刻意不这么做。

## 开发

```bash
node scripts/verify-client.mjs
```

该脚本用一个打桩的模块表和小型渲染器载入 `lib/client.js`，然后断言：工厂与导出形态正确、
`inject` 数组存在、座位注册命中 `settings.models.footer`、**投影确实过滤掉了被隐藏的模型**、
**折叠只影响渲染而不影响 hidden 集或选择器**，同时覆盖空/畸形快照、服务缺失、本地存储被拒
等降级路径。

## 许可证

MIT。见 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 与 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

版本变更见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

plugins.description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 插件：完成任务、需要选择或需要批准时发送桌面通知并播放提示音 · Desktop notifications + sound for DSH on Linux
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-notify-linux

**English** | [中文文档](README.zh.md)

Desktop notifications and a chime for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) on
Linux + GNOME. DSH tells you when it has finished a turn, when it is waiting for you to
choose something, when a tool call needs your approval, and when something failed.

The notifications are sent **by the DSH host process**, not by the browser page — so they
still arrive when the page is in a background tab, when the window is minimized, or when
the page is closed entirely.

- No npm runtime dependencies (the host half uses only Node built-ins)
- Notifications via `notify-send`, sounds via `paplay` with a `canberra-gtk-play` fallback
- Browser-side fallback (in-page toast, Web Notification, synthesized Web Audio chime)
  for environments where the system paths are unavailable
- All switches configurable in the DSH Settings page or by editing a single JSON file

---

## What it notifies you about

Four event kinds. Each one has its own toggle, its own urgency and icon, and its own
sound (except `turnEnd`, which uses the theme you select).

| Kind | Trigger | Notification title | Urgency | Icon | Sound |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `turnEnd` | The whole agent turn is stopping — the model no longer owes a response | `DSH 已完成任务` | normal | `dialog-information` | selected theme |
| `question` | The model requests an answer from you (single choice / multi choice / free text) | `DSH 正在等待你的选择` | normal | `dialog-information` | `message-new-instant` |
| `approval` | A tool call is waiting for a human to allow it | `DSH 需要你的批准` | normal | `dialog-information` | `dialog-information` |
| `error` | A step or a whole turn failed | `DSH 执行出错` | critical | `dialog-error` | `dialog-error` |

The notification body identifies the session, so you can tell which piece of work it
refers to. Format: `<workspace> · <8-char session id>` plus the event detail, e.g.

```
DSH 已完成任务
default-workspace · 44b6a957 的回合已结束
```

`turnEnd` fires on `agent/turn-stopping` — the point where the turn is genuinely over.
Tool-call round trips do not trigger it; only the end of the whole turn does.

> The notification strings are currently Chinese (they are emitted from the host half).
> The Settings page itself is fully localized (Chinese and English).

---

## Why the host half sends the notifications

A browser-only notification scheme has a hard limitation: it only works while the page is
open and the browser is alive. Switch to another window, minimize the browser, or close
the tab, and the notification is simply never delivered.

The DSH host process lives longer than the page. `notify-send` goes through the GNOME
notification center, so the notification — and the sound — still reach you when the page
is unfocused, when the browser is in the background, or when the page is not open at all.

The browser half therefore does three different things instead of duplicating delivery:

| Half | File | Responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| Host | `index.js` (500 lines) | Listens to the four events, sends the real system notification and sound, persists config, serves the HTTP API |
| Browser | `client.js` (682 lines) | Settings page, in-page toast overlay, and fallback via Web Notification / Web Audio when the host could not deliver |

Whether the browser falls back is decided by two booleans the host returns with each
event — `desktop` and `sound`, meaning "this was actually dispatched". If the system
notification did go out, the browser stays quiet, so you are never notified twice.

---

## Requirements

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Platform | **Linux + GNOME** (verified on Manjaro GNOME, Wayland) |
| DSH | Any DSH build with the Cordis plugin system (`webServer`, `settings.section` slots) |
| Node | **>= 22** (DSH's own requirement) |
| Notifications | `notify-send` from **libnotify** |
| Sounds | `paplay` from **pulseaudio-utils**, or `canberra-gtk-play` from **libcanberra** |
| Sound files | `/usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo` (the freedesktop sound theme) |
| npm dependencies | **none** — `package.json` has no `dependencies` |

Everything external is optional in the sense that the plugin degrades gracefully: if
`notify-send` is missing, the plugin reports that capability as unavailable and the
browser half can take over with Web Notifications. Nothing is ever awaited on the event
path — a missing or failing command can never stall the agent.

The plugin probes for its tools at runtime and reports the result in the Settings page
(`notify-send`, `paplay`, `canberra-gtk-play` — each shown as available or not).

---

## Installation

This is a DSH Cordis plugin **bundle**. Install it through DSH's plugin manager
(`plugin_manager`, action `install_bundle`), pointing it at either:

- the **local directory** — `/home/wlaeg/文档/deepseek-harness/default-workspace/dsh-notify`
- or the **Git repository** — `https://github.com/Wlaeg/dsh-notify-linux`

The bundle declares its own patch in `package.json`:

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" },
    "client": { "platform": "web", "immediately": true, "inject": [] }
  }
}
```

and the patch is a single `insert` that mounts the host half:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-notify-linux
      name: 'dsh-notify-linux'
      config: {}
```

The browser half is declared by `dsh.client` and bound to the row whose `name` is the
bare package name — subpath rows do not carry a browser half.

After installing, the plugin is active. Reload the DSH Web UI page so the browser half
registers its Settings section. There is no separate CLI install step.

> **Replacing an already-installed copy** (for example after editing the source) needs a
> restart of the DSH host process. The plugin manager rewrites the dependency and the
> patch immediately, but the running process keeps the JS module generation it loaded at
> startup, so the old routes and handlers stay live until DSH restarts. A page reload is
> not enough. The host half's HTTP routes make this easy to see: while a stale copy is
> still running, `GET /api/dsh-notify-linux/config` answers `401` because the old
> `/api/dsh-notify` prefix route is still claiming the path.

---

## Settings

The Settings page section is called **Task Notifications** (导航项「任务通知」,
registered on the `settings.section` slot at order 30). It contains:

- the master switch
- the four event toggles
- system notification / sound toggles and the completion-sound theme
- subagent, focus-only and cooldown options
- the browser-fallback group with the current browser notification permission
- a **Try it** row with one button per event kind, using the exact same delivery path as
  a real notification
- a capability row showing whether `notify-send`, `paplay` and `canberra-gtk-play` were
  found on this machine

> **Screenshot placeholder** — no screenshot is included in this repository yet, so no
> image is referenced here. This block is an explicit placeholder, not a broken link.

---

## Configuration

All options live in one file:

```
<DSH profile directory>/dsh-notify-linux.json
```

The profile directory is resolved as `$DSH_PROFILE_DIR`, or otherwise
`$DSH_HOME/profiles/$DSH_PROFILE` (defaults: `~/.dsh/profiles/web`). On this machine that
is `~/.dsh/profiles/web/dsh-notify-linux.json`.

The file is written **atomically** (temp file + `rename`) with mode **0600**, so a reader
never sees half-written JSON. You can edit it directly — it is re-read on every
notification — or use the Settings page, which writes through the same code path.

### Defaults

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | Master switch. Off disables every notification. |
| `systemNotify` | boolean | `true` | Send a desktop notification via `notify-send`. |
| `systemSound` | boolean | `true` | Play a sound from the system sound theme. |
| `browserToast` | boolean | `true` | Show the in-page toast overlay. |
| `browserNotify` | boolean | `true` | Use Web Notification as a fallback. Requires browser permission. |
| `browserSound` | boolean | `false` | Use the synthesized Web Audio chime as a fallback. |
| `soundTheme` | string | `'complete'` | Sound used for `turnEnd`. One

plugins.description: Read text aloud in the DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a speak tool for the agent, per-message and select-to-read buttons in the Web UI, and per-language voices — via the macOS say command.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-speak

Read text aloud in the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH), on the machine running it, with the macOS `say` command.

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

| Entry | Where | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `speak` tool | the model can call it | reads text aloud, or stops with `stop: true` |
| 🔊 message action | the action strip under every finalized assistant reply | click to read that reply, click again to **stop** |
| 🔊 select-to-read bubble | above any text you select on the page | "select and read", like select-to-translate |
| ⚙ reading settings | speaker-gear button in the composer dock | per-language voice, rate, and Han-character bias |

Chinese, English, Japanese, and Korean are detected per character, and **every script run is read by its own system voice** in its own `say` process. One reading plays at a time; a new request replaces it.

Audio comes out of the machine running DSH, never the browser. No network calls, no API keys, no model downloads.

## Requirements

- **macOS** — playback shells out to `say`. (Linux with `spd-say`, or a browser-side `speechSynthesis` variant, would be a separate provider; not implemented.)
- **DSH 0.2.x** — the desktop app, or any profile whose page is served to a browser.
- **Node 20+** only if you want to run the offline test.

## Install

### A. Through the plugin manager (recommended)

1. Open DSH → **Plugins** (Settings → Plugins, or the Plugins panel in the sidebar).
2. **Install bundle** and paste the repository URL:

   ```
   https://github.com/RinChanNOWWW/dsh-speak
   ```

   A git URL, a local absolute path, and an npm name are all accepted.
3. The bundle patch inserts one row (`speak`) and the browser half is served automatically — there is no build step and no dependencies to install.
4. Use it. If the buttons do not appear, reload the page once.

> The in-app plugin manager is the intended path for the desktop app, which is why the `dsh plugin` CLI refuses that profile. For any other profile the CLI works too — see below.

### B. Manual install into a profile

Use this when you want the plugin to live outside the profile's `node_modules`.

1. Copy the package next to the profile's patch file:

   ```
   $DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/plugins/dsh-speak/{package.json,index.js,client.js}
   ```

2. Add one row to `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`:

   ```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: speak
         name: ./plugins/dsh-speak/index.js
   ```

   The `name` **must point at the entry file**: the loader resolves a `.`-prefixed name with `import(new URL(name, baseUrl))`, so a directory cannot be imported, and the browser half is found by walking up from that file to the nearest `package.json`.

3. Restart the app, or let the profile reload — an **added** row is picked up live.
4. To change host code later: write a **new file** (`index.v2.js`…) and **remove then re-insert** the row. A mounted row is not re-imported when only its `name` changes, and a `?v=` query in the name is rejected by the loader. `deploy.sh` automates exactly this.

### C. A `dsh web` profile

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/RinChanNOWWW/dsh-speak
```

That installs the package; the bundle also has to be listed in that profile's `package.json` → `dsh.profile.bundles` for its patch to be applied. The in-app plugin manager does both steps for you.

## Use

### Ask the assistant

> "read this aloud" / "读一下这段" / "stop reading" / "别读了"

| `speak` argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `text` | text to read; markdown is stripped; required unless `stop` is true |
| `stop` | `true` stops the current reading instead of starting one |
| `language` | `zh` / `en` / `ja` / `ko` — biases ambiguous text (bare Han characters) and acts as the voice fallback; **does not** force one voice for everything |
| `voice` | an exact macOS voice name (`Tingting`, `Kyoko`, `Yuna`, `Samantha`…); reads the whole text in that one voice |
| `rate` | words per minute, 80–500 |
| `wait` | wait for the whole reading instead of returning as soon as it starts |

It returns the character count, the languages found, the voices used, and the **per-run sequence**, e.g. `zh:Tingting -> ko:Yuna -> ja:Kyoko -> en:Samantha`.

### From the interface

- **Message action** — 🔊 under a finalized reply. While it reads, the icon highlights and its sound waves pulse; click again to stop. If another reply is being read it dims (clicking switches to this one), and a failure shows red with a retry hint.
- **Select to read** — select text anywhere that is not an input; a small bubble appears above the selection (below it when there is no room, always clamped to the viewport). Click it to read; the bubble **stays and becomes "stop reading"**. Selections inside inputs, textareas, and `contenteditable` regions are ignored, as is anything over 20,000 characters.
- **Settings** — the speaker-gear button in the composer dock, or the gear inside the selection bubble.

### Stopping a reading

| Way | Notes |
|---|---|
| the same bubble, now "停止朗读 / Stop reading" | it no longer dismisses itself when it starts |
| the floating **stop** pill, bottom right | appears while *anything* plays — including a reading the agent started through the tool — because the page keeps a slow status heartbeat |
| **⌘⇧S** (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+S) | works anywhere, including inside the composer; rebindable in DSH's shortcut settings as `speak.stop` |
| ask the assistant | `speak` with `stop: true` |

## Settings

The panel offers, per language (中文 / English / 日本語 / 한국어), the voices actually installed on the machine — recommended ones first — plus a rate slider, a **Bare Han** switch (whether Han characters without kana read as Chinese or Japanese), a preview button, and save state.

They are stored in `$DSH_HOME/dsh-speak.settings.json` and also drive the `speak` tool, so the assistant reads with the voices you picked. Explicit tool arguments override them for one reading.

```bash
curl -s $DSH_WEB_URL/api/dsh-speak/settings   # installed voices + current settings
```

## How it works

Two halves in one package (one loader row):

- `index.js` — the host half. Registers the `speak` tool and four routes on the composition's web server:

  | Route | Purpose |
  |---|---|
  | `POST /api/dsh-speak` | `{action:"speak", text?/sessionId+messageId}` or `{action:"stop"}` |
  | `GET /api/dsh-speak/status` | what is playing now: source, message identity, languages, voices, sequence, progress |
  | `GET/POST /api/dsh-speak/settings` | read/write preferences; lists installed voices |
  | `GET/POST /api/dsh-speak/client` | the browser half's report channel (see *Diagnostics*) |

- `client.js` — the browser half, a prebuilt bundle in the format the client module loader expects (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({id, factory})`). It registers four slots: `conversation.chat.assistant-actions`, two entries in `shell.overlay`, and `conversation.composer.dock`.

Language handling:

- Kana makes a Han/kana run Japanese; Hangul is Korean; Latin is English; a kana-free Han run follows the **Bare Han** setting.
- Sentence-ending punctuation and script changes split runs, so `中文句子。日本語の文。` keeps two voices.
- Latin runs shorter than `MIN_LATIN_RUN` (12 characters of their own script, default) are folded into the surrounding language, so an acronym inside Chinese prose does not flip the voice for three words. CJK and Hangul runs are never absorbed.
- Playback is one `say` process per run, started when the previous one exits: `say` has **no inline voice switch** (its `[[...]]` commands cover rate, pitch, volume, and input mode only), and an unsupported `[[voice:…]]` is read out as literal text.

## Diagnostics

The browser half reports what it loaded and did to `GET /api/dsh-speak/client` (a 200-entry ring buffer in the host): `hello` (build + registered entries), `style`, `mounted`, `visibility`, `rendered` (the measured box, whether it is inside the viewport, and which ancestor would break `position: fixed`), `error` (with the component stack), plus settings and playback transitions. That is how "I clicked and nothing appeared" gets answered without devtools.
